script.line: Woh toh chaar saal ki hai!

review.notes: Every kitty has an Ishita buying extra tickets and every group jokes the host's family always wins. Opens on Housie in progress like our winner (cage, prize, 'Mera!'). Quiz pause lists only Ishita's names, so the Bittu reveal is a true surprise and a see-it ticket. Claim before reveal: 'Mera hi hoga! Chaaron mere!' then the drop. Button flips the opening line to the host. Endings tried: (1) didi wins and takes the mixer home, (2) saas wins over video call, (3) Bittu; kept 3, it flips who wins and gives the comment bait 'kisne guess kiya?'. Rewrote once: first pass had Megha and Tina too (5 faces), cut to 3.

review.notes: Real kitty scene (calls from home in the middle of Housie, named in team feedback). Lead is Shruti (last reel's lead was Myra), with her strict hisaab flavour ('Barabar hisaab!'). One rule pinned as a counting chip so a muted viewer always knows the stake. Game played 3 times (charger, namak, fridge) then flipped on the rule maker, the same shape that made the door-arrivals winner work (host breaks her own rule, opening line thrown back), here tested as a musical. Twist is a see-it phone screen. Claim before reveal: Shruti brags 'silent pe hai' right before her screen lights up. The 'Teen!' chorus answer is the laugh: every woman knows the seeti count. One line per shot except quick comeback pairs, every shot well under 5 s, pace 26, about 36 s. Endings tried: Shruti switches every phone off (flat); husbands all on one group call (too many people, confusing); the rule thrown back with the chorus (kept, loops into the opening). Kind humour, no money troubles.

review.notes: Fix of KG-2026-11-15-a, which failed QA on voice pace (2.18 w/s, the lead voices Shruti and Aditi are the slowest in the cast). Changes: pace 27 to 33, per-line rate -4% for Shruti and -8% for Aditi (her last Hmm. Do laana. keeps her slow default for the deadpan), and the rupee numbers written out in the captions (gyarah sau, paanch sau ek) so the word count matches what the voice actually says. Expected pace about 2.6 w/s and length about 31 s. Script unchanged otherwise. Real kitty scene: the Housie table the day after a shaadi the whole gang attended, and the shagun-vs-plate hisaab every guest secretly does. Chip is a meter that moves almost every shot so a muted viewer always knows the stake (who got her shagun's worth). Bas?!', and Shruti 'Toh main jeeti!' right before Aditi's three thalis drop. Each lady says what only she would: Shruti's calculator and steel dabba, Megha's diet and cheat day, Aditi's one-word Housie calls and 'Hmm.' Twist is see-it (three thalis pop, chip 300%). Lead Tanya (last reel's lead was Myra). Four characters, three per shot. Claim before reveal: Tanya's victory lap 'Rule se sab aate hain!' right before the ping. Twist is see-it: the saas's message on Tanya's phone with the date, and Myra joins the dots out loud. Button mirrors the opening: Tanya's rule comes back as a chorus, and her own refrain 'Do hazaar.' comes back from Shruti. Rewrites: ending 1 (Tanya cancels Lucknow) made her the winner, cut; ending 2 (saas calls on speaker) needed a voice outside the cast, swapped for the chat screen; kept the double refrain flip. Pace: every two-line shot 8 words or fewer, hold 0.1, one silenceBefore, pace 28. Kind humour: the joke is on kitty loyalty and shaadi season, nobody's money worries (the fine is a group rule, not hardship). Dates: post lands around end of November, December kitty still ahead.

experiment.hook: Ruhi as a TV anchor with her phone as the mic on the Tulsi Vivah home art, heartbeat at 0 s, mascot ball spinning above, chip 'BREAKING: AANGAN MEIN SHAADI!' pinned from the first frame, she says 'Breaking news! Aaj Tulsi ji ki shaadi!'

ideas.idea: Hook: Diwali taash kitty, mid-round, Tanya pushes her whole pile of rajma chips in: "Blind chal!" and Ruhi and Myra freeze. Context: Shruti reads her hisaab notebook aloud (every chip is Rs 1, Tanya is already Rs 40 down) and the whole table leans in for the show. Ending: Tanya flips a 2, a 5 and a 9, nothing at all, and calmly drops Rs 40 in coins into the steel bowl: "Lakshmi ji kal aayengi, aaj sirf darshan."
ideas.format: Card table close-ups with chips and notebook as the stake chip, one reveal shot of the three cards, max 3 characters per shot
ideas.source: Trend: Diwali taash night (Curly Tales) + Festival window: Diwali 8 Nov (9 days away)

ideas.idea: Hook: Full House claimed at the first kitty after Diwali, Tanya proudly lifts the prize: five half-open mithai boxes taped together. Context: one by one Ruhi, Myra and Shruti recognise their own leftover boxes in the pile ("Yeh toh mera soan... matlab mera kaju katli hai!") while Tanya insists it is a 'Diwali special hamper'. Ending: the winner Myra opens the top box and finds only the silver paper and one broken laddoo, holds it up to camera.
ideas.format: Housie table cold open on the claim, prize reveal close-up, recognition reactions, one-object ending shot
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Diwali 9 days + Bhai Dooj (post-Diwali kitty 9-12 Nov) + Diwali hamper season

ideas.idea: Hook: kitty draw, Shruti opens the chit: "Is mahine ki kitty... Ruhi!" and Ruhi grabs the Rs 20,000 envelope. Context: before she can count it, Diwali bills slide out of her purse one by one (saree, crackers for the kids, gift for the maid, mithai) and Shruti totals them on her calculator, chip running down. Ending: the calculator shows Rs 20 left; Ruhi puts the Rs 20 note back in the kitty bowl: "Agle mahine ka advance."
ideas.format: Chit-draw cold open, purse and bill close-ups, calculator screen as the countdown chip, one-object ending
ideas.source: Trend: One-claim proof reel (6 to 18 s, one claim resolved on screen) + Festival window: Diwali 8 Nov (9 days away)

ideas.idea: Taash Housie: each lady gets 5 playing cards face up as her ticket; the host flips cards from a second deck and calls them out, and whoever holds that card turns it face down. First to turn all 5 down shouts "Diwali!" and wins. Twist: whenever the host flips a Joker, every lady must pass one card of her choice to the lady on her right, mid-game. 8 to 20 ladies (use 2 to 4 decks), 10 to 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, the 5-card ticket, the calling deck, the Joker pass twist, winner slide
ideas.source: Trend: Diwali taash night (Curly Tales) + Housie with a twist + Festival window: Diwali 8 Nov (9 days away)

ideas.idea: Matchstick Shubh Diwali: each lady gets a steel plate and a box of used or unlit matchsticks and has 1 minute to spell SHUBH DIWALI on her plate as many times as she can. Twist: every 20 seconds the host shouts "Pataka!" and everyone passes her plate to the left and carries on with the neighbour's half-done letters. Count full words at the end. No flames at all. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, top-down plate with matchstick letters, the Pataka pass twist, scoring slide, winner slide
ideas.source: Trend: Matchstick one-minute game (Zee News Diwali games) + One-minute game + Festival window: Diwali 8 Nov (9 days away)

ideas.idea: Patakha says: everyone stands in a circle and learns 5 cracker moves: chakri = spin once, rocket = jump, anaar = both arms up, phuljhadi = wave hands, bomb = clap and sit down. The host calls crackers faster and faster and anyone who does the wrong move is out. Twist: the host sometimes calls a fake cracker ("Murga bomb!", "Chocolate anaar!") and anyone who moves is out, and in the final round she calls two crackers at once. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 minutes, nothing needed.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, the 5 cracker moves as icons, the fake-cracker twist, final round slide, winner slide
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Diwali 9 days + Bhai Dooj + Looks easy, isn't (control challenge pattern)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie in progress, the cage stops as Shruti's phone pings: Tina in the group chat, a photo of herself on a ladder, "Maine toh pankhe ke upar bhi saaf kar diya!" Context: between numbers every lady at the table posts bigger safai proof (inside the fridge, the AC filter, the chandelier bulb by bulb) and the game stalls. Ending: Tanya, the host, slowly looks up at her own fan over the Housie table, and on the next spin a ball of dust drops right onto her ticket.
ideas.format: Living-room sitcom, Housie table + group chat phone inserts (max 3 per shot), dusty fan close-up at the end
ideas.source: Trend: Overachiever Diwali safai (1M+ views, https://www.shethepeople.tv/viral-video/woman-cleaning-window-viral) + our winner Diwali safai wali Housie (1161 views, 5 shares, 5 saves) + Festival window: Diwali 8 Nov (10 days away)

ideas.idea: Hook: group video call 10 minutes before the Diwali kitty, Tanya, Ruhi and Myra all in nightsuits with towels on their heads: "Bas nikal rahi hoon!" Context: Shruti, already at the host's house in full lehenga, counts down "Teen, do, ek" and hard cut: all three walk in fully dressed, gold and sparkle. Ending: Myra sits down for Housie, the pallu slips, and under the lehenga dupatta she is still wearing the nightsuit top: "Video mein toh upar wala hi dikhta hai."
ideas.format: Split-screen video call to living room, one hard-cut transition beat, Housie table at the end
ideas.source: Trend: Aunty glow-up transition (23M views, ThePrint) + Video call Tambola (69 likes, 14 comments) + Festival window: Diwali 8 Nov (10 days away)

ideas.idea: Hook: Full House just claimed and Tanya opens the snack box: empty. "Chai ke saath kuch nahi hai!" Context: Ruhi, Shruti and Myra order on three different apps at the same time and Shruti calls the ETAs like Housie numbers ("Saat minute! Nau minute! Bas do!"). Ending: the doorbell rings, three delivery boys at the door with the same bhujia packet, and Tanya hands each a ticket: "Ek line khel ke jao, Diwali hai!"
ideas.format: Living-room sitcom + phone app screens, front door ending (max 3 per shot)
ideas.source: Trend: 10-minute delivery Diwali (https://www.freepressjournal.in/lifestyle/man-orders-sweets-from-swiggy-blinkit-zepto-gifts-it-back-to-delivery-partners-internet-loves-this-diwali-gesture) + Festival window: Diwali 8 Nov (10 days away)

ideas.idea: Jhaadu golf: two unlit diyas on the floor make a goal by the door, and each lady gets 30 seconds to sweep a crumpled newspaper ball through it with a phool jhaadu. Twist: one eye covered with a dupatta ("safai mein aankh mein dhool chali gayi") and the host scatters a handful of puffed rice as extra 'kachra' that must go through the goal too; every grain left behind is minus one. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, props (jhaadu, newspaper ball, 2 diyas, puffed rice), the one-eye twist, scoring, messy floor last slide
ideas.source: Trend: Overachiever Diwali safai (https://www.shethepeople.tv/viral-video/woman-cleaning-window-viral) + Looks easy, isn't (298 likes, 25 comments) + Festival window: Diwali 8 Nov (10 days away)

ideas.idea: Diwali bonus auction: every lady gets 10 paper notes of 'Rs 100' and the host auctions 8 sealed envelopes one by one. Inside: a chocolate, a toffee, "sweep the room", "sing a Diwali song", "pay Rs 200 back", a hair clip. Twist: one envelope holds the real kitty prize chit, and the host gives one true hint before the bidding on each envelope. Unspent notes are worth nothing at the end. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, paper notes and envelopes, sample envelope chits, the hint twist, winner slide
ideas.source: Trend: Bumper prize Tambola (840 likes, https://www.instagram.com/reel/De8Lbq1Ddg7/) + Festival window: Diwali 8 Nov (10 days away)

ideas.idea: Gathbandhan phere: pairs are tied at the wrist with a dupatta and must take 7 phere around a chair, picking up one item from a thaal on every round (supari, bangle, bindi pack, haldi, coin, flower, diya) using only their tied hands. Twist: on rounds 4 to 7 the host calls a Housie number and the pair must shout the number's kitty nickname together before moving on. Fastest pair wins. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, tying the dupatta, the 7-item thaal, the Housie nickname twist, winning pair slide
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Tulsi Vivah + Dev Uthani 20-21 Nov (https://hindutone.com/festivals/dev-uthani-ekadashi-tulsi-vivah-2026-singapore-date/) + Shaadi season kitty

ideas.idea: Hook: Diwali kitty, Tanya opens the hamper Ruhi brought her and pulls out a card that reads "With love, Tanya", her own gift to Ruhi last year. Context: Ruhi swears it is a new one while Shruti flips over the other hampers on the table and finds every tag already has someone else's name crossed out. Ending: all the hampers go back in the middle as a Housie prize, and Tanya writes one new tag for the lot: "Kitty Gang ki taraf se".
ideas.format: Living-room sitcom, Diwali decor, hamper table close-ups (max 3 per shot)
ideas.source: Trend: Diwali hamper season (https://www.hollywoodreporterindia.com/features/insight/diwali-2026-four-seasons-hotel-mumbai-launches-festive-hampers-range) + Festival window: Diwali 8 Nov (11 days away)

ideas.idea: Hook: Children's Day 'Bachpan' theme kitty, Housie in progress, Shruti as class monitor writes "TALKING: Tanya, Ruhi" on a whiteboard because they gossiped over a number. Context: the gang in two plaits, school ties and steel tiffins; every claim must be made with a raised hand, "Ma'am, Jaldi Five!". Ending: Tanya's real son walks in from tuition and stares at his mother in a school uniform; she raises her hand, "Ma'am, may I go?"
ideas.format: Living-room sitcom, school theme decor (blackboard, bags, tiffins), Housie at the table
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Children's Day 14 Nov (17 days away) + Topical ripple into the kittyverse (ThePrint)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Ruhi joins on video call from home because of Diwali safai, her phone propped on the fruit bowl, "Mera ticket bhi cut karna!" Context: her camera shows only the ceiling fan, she claims Jaldi Five on mute, and Shruti keeps shouting "Unmute karo!" into the phone. Ending: Ruhi finally unmutes to shout Full House, and behind her the saasu maa is holding her own ticket, "Main bhi khel rahi thi!"
ideas.format: Living-room sitcom + phone screen video call inserts (max 3 per shot)
ideas.source: Trend: Video call Tambola (69 likes, 14 comments, https://www.instagram.com/reel/De_3q3Wp4gh/)

ideas.idea: Bachpan pencil drop: tie a pencil on a 2-foot string to the back of each lady's waist; in 1 minute she must lower it into an empty bottle on the floor without using her hands. Twist: for Children's Day, she must sing a nursery rhyme the whole time (Machli jal ki rani, Twinkle twinkle) and the moment she stops singing, the host knocks the bottle over and she restarts. Play in heats of 5; fastest time wins.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, setup (pencil, string, bottle), rules, twist, winner
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Children's Day 14 Nov (17 days away) + One-minute game

ideas.idea: Mute Tambola: normal tickets, but the host only mouths each number with no sound, like a muted video call, and everyone must lip-read before cutting. Twist: every 5th number the host suddenly 'unmutes' and says a different number out loud than the one she mouths; anyone who cuts the spoken one loses that line. 15 to 20 minutes for a full game.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, how to call, twist, sample numbers, winner
ideas.source: Trend: Video call Tambola (69 likes, 14 comments, https://www.instagram.com/reel/De_3q3Wp4gh/)

ideas.idea: Hamper unwrap: a toffee or chocolate is wrapped in 8 layers of newspaper and tape like an overpacked Diwali hamper and passed around to music. When the music stops, the holder puts on kitchen gloves and gets 10 seconds to tear one layer. Twist: each layer has a chit inside with a dare (say 'Happy Diwali' in 3 languages, name the last gift you regifted, compliment the host's curtains) that must be done before passing on. Whoever opens the last layer keeps the prize.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, setup (newspaper, tape, gloves), dare chits, twist, winner
ideas.source: Trend: Diwali hamper season (https://www.hollywoodreporterindia.com/features/insight/diwali-2026-four-seasons-hotel-mumbai-launches-festive-hampers-range) + Festival window: Diwali 8 Nov (11 days away)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie in progress, Tanya's phone buzzes with her husband's text "Dhanteras pe kya laun?" and she types "Kuch nahi chahiye" while cutting a number; Shruti and Ruhi freeze. Context: Shruti grabs the phone and between every called number the gang dictates a full list (chandi ka sikka, payal, naya cooker). Ending: Dhanteras evening, the husband walks in holding one steel chammach, "Tumne hi toh kaha tha kuch nahi", and Tanya's face says it all.
ideas.format: Living-room sitcom, Housie in progress + phone screen inserts (max 3 per shot)
ideas.source: Trend: Pati ko 'kuch nahi chahiye' (our reel, skip 32.8%, 11 shares) + Festival window: Dhanteras 6 Nov (10 days away)

ideas.idea: Hook: Halloween kitty, Housie already running, Shruti in a witch hat calls "Number 13, bhoot ka ghar!" Context: Myra arrives late in a full Diwali lehenga, "Mujhe laga Halloween koi naya festive look hai"; Ruhi turns her into a chudail in 10 seconds with a black dupatta, kajal and a jhaadu. Ending: the spooky surprise promised to everyone: the lights go off for the cake, and Myra, still in lehenga and witch hat, shouts Full House in the dark.
ideas.format: Living-room sitcom, Halloween decor (pumpkins, cobwebs, diyas), Housie at the table
ideas.source: Trend: Halloween kitty theme (107 likes, 21 comments, https://www.instagram.com/reel/De6bjjove0p/), Halloween 31 Oct

ideas.idea: Hook: Tanya holds up a gift-wrapped mixer grinder, "Diwali kitty ka bumper Full House prize!" and everyone grabs extra tickets. ideas.idea: Hook: the first kitty after Diwali, Housie running, Myra pushes the samosa plate away: "Diwali ke baad diet!" and Tanya and Ruhi nod, "Haan, main bhi." Context: on every called number one of them quietly takes "bas ek" kaju katli from the leftover Diwali box. Ending: the host lifts the lid to serve and the box is empty; all three point at each other with crumbs on their sarees.
ideas.format: Living-room sitcom, opens on the game
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Diwali 8 Nov (post-Diwali kitty) + Expectation vs reality split

ideas.idea: Shaadi ka suitcase: pairs get one small bag or suitcase and a shared centre table with 12 household things (folded saree, bangle box, hair dryer, chappal pair, charger, dupatta, makeup pouch, shawl, steel tiffin, slippers, perfume, mithai box). In 60 seconds one lady hands and the other packs, then they must zip it shut. Twist: at 30 seconds the host reads a husband's text "Mera kurta bhi rakh lena" and every pair must fit one more item or lose. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Pairs race, top-down
ideas.source: Trend: Pack in 60 seconds (partystuff.in) + shaadi season

ideas.idea: Shagun ka lifafa: each lady gets 3 envelopes, a stack of play notes (10, 20, 50, 100, 500) and a few Re 1 coins. The host calls a relation and an amount ("Bua ki beti, 1100", "Padosi ka beta, 501") and the first lady to hold up a sealed envelope with the exact amount wins the round. Twist: every shagun must end in 1, so if you forget the Re 1 coin your envelope is 'kanjoos' and you lose a point. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Speed round, everyone plays at once
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Dev Uthani 20 Nov + Tulsi Vivah 21 Nov opens shaadi season (hindutone.com)

ideas.idea: Mehendi mein naam dhoondo: before the kitty the host draws a big mehendi-style pattern on chart paper and hides every lady's name in the swirls, like a bride hides the dulha's name. On the day the sheet goes on the table and everyone has 2 minutes to find and circle her own name. Twist: the last lady to find hers becomes the dulha and must do a 10-second baraat entry to a dhol beat from a phone. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Search race on one big sheet
ideas.source: Trend: Shaadi season kitty + Festival window: Tulsi Vivah 21 Nov

ideas.idea: Hook: doorbell, Ruhi blocks her doorway in a nightsuit and shawl holding the kitty pot: "Aaj Pajama kitty! Saree mein aayi toh entry nahi!" Context: each ring brings one guest who half-follows the rule (Shruti in pajamas with full bridal makeup, Myra in a saree with pajama hems peeking out, Tanya in a nightsuit plus heels), chip 'PAJAMA SCORE' changing every shot. Ending: the group photo timer starts and Ruhi whips off her shawl to show a silk saree underneath, and the three guests throw her own line back: "Saree mein aayi toh entry nahi!"
ideas.format: Door-arrivals (one guest per ring, score chip, host breaks her own rule)
ideas.source: Trend: Cozy pajama winter kitty (thebash.com) + Admin breaks her own rule (our KG-2026-10-27-c, 4938 views, skip 25.6%)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Shruti slams the hisaab register on the table: "Diwali ke chakkar mein teen logon ki kitty pending hai!" chip 'PENDING: Rs 6,000'. Context: on each called number one lady gives her excuse (Tanya: "Bonus abhi aaya nahi", Myra: "Dhanteras pe sikka le liya", Ruhi: "Gifts mein chala gaya") and the chip drops as each one pays up with a sigh. Ending: Ruhi grabs the register to check the total and reads the first name on the pending list aloud: "Shruti, Rs 2,000." Shruti quietly cuts a number.
ideas.format: Housie-in-progress sitcom with a money chip
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Diwali 8 Nov (first kitty after Diwali) + Admin breaks her own rule (our best hook shape) + Housie money fight

ideas.idea: Hook: Children's Day tiffin kitty, Housie running, Myra pops open a steel school tiffin: "Aaj recess wala lunch!" and Tanya and Shruti hold up theirs (jam bread, Maggi, aloo paratha roll). Context: they swap tiffins like school kids, and Tanya opens hers to find a crushed Parle-G and a juice box when the phone rings: her son on video call from school, holding her kitty paneer tikka, "Mummy, mera tiffin kahan hai?" Ending: split screen, Tanya with the Parle-G, her son happily eating her party starters with his whole class around him.
ideas.format: Housie-in-progress sitcom + call from home
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Children's Day 14 Nov (11 days, +2) + Memory lane kitty

ideas.idea: Dry fruit sorting, blindfolded: each lady gets a steel plate with a mixed fistful of leftover Diwali dry fruits (kaju, badam, kishmish, akhrot, pista) and 5 small katoris. Blindfolded with a dupatta, she has 1 minute to sort them by touch only. Twist: the host secretly mixes in a few peanuts and chana; every one that lands in the kaju katori costs 2 points, and the lowest scorer must bring a dry fruit box to the next kitty. 8 to 20 ladies in rounds of 4 to 5, 10 to 15 minutes.
ideas.format: One-minute blindfold challenge in heats
ideas.source: Trend: Post-Diwali dry fruit box glut (Financial Express) + One-minute game

ideas.idea: Regift ki chori: everyone brings one unopened Diwali gift box from home, wrapped in newspaper, with the original gift tag still stuck inside. Chits decide the order; lady 1 opens a gift, every next lady either opens a new one or steals an opened one (a gift can be stolen only twice, then it is locked). Crazy twist: when a gift is opened, the tag is read aloud, so everyone learns whose Diwali gift was passed on and the original giver is often sitting right there. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 to 20 minutes.
ideas.format: Steal-or-open gift swap
ideas.source: Trend: Post-Diwali dry fruit box glut + Cozy pajama winter kitty (regift swap theme, thebash.com)

ideas.idea: Mungfali ginti: a big bowl of roasted peanuts in shells sits in the middle; each lady gets 1 minute and an empty katori to shell as many peanuts as she can, using one hand only. Count the peanuts, not the shells. Crazy twist: the host has hidden 5 peanuts painted with sindoor or food colour in the bowl, and anyone who finds one doubles her count, so the last 10 seconds turn into a dig through the bowl. 8 to 20 ladies in heats, 10 to 15 minutes, chai on the side.
ideas.format: One-minute speed round with a hidden bonus
ideas.source: Trend: Cozy pajama winter kitty (thebash.com, first cold weeks of November)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running at Tanya's first kitty after Diwali, she waves at her buffet: "Aaj live pasta counter aur sushi!" and the smell of Maggi floats in from the kitchen. Context: on every called number one more lady slips away (Ruhi, then Myra, then Shruti with her ticket) and the chip 'PASTA COUNTER: 0 plates' never moves. Ending: Tanya storms into the kitchen to find all of them crowded round the cook's Maggi pot with steel katoris; she sighs, grabs a katori and holds it out: "Mera bhi ek."
ideas.format: Housie-in-progress sitcom, living room to kitchen, counter chip, one-pot ending shot (max 3 per shot)
ideas.source: Trend: Maggi counter beats the fancy buffet (republicworld.com, 15M+ views) + LEARNINGS: open on a game in progress

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Shruti sets the rule: "Ghar se call aaya toh ek number kategi!" and Ruhi's phone rings at once: "Mummy, charger kahan hai?" Context: on every number another phone rings ("Namak kahan hai?", "Geyser on nahi ho raha", "Dadi ki dawai?") and each lady answers without looking up while her ticket loses a cut. Ending: all four husbands on one group video call holding the same hissing pressure cooker: "Seeti kitni?" and the whole kitty answers in chorus "Teen!", switches the phones off and cuts the next number.
ideas.format: Housie-in-progress sitcom + phone call screens, chorus ending, caption 'Tag your Ghar ki Raunak'
ideas.source: Trend: Tag your Ghar ki Raunak (our reel, 2182 views, 11 shares) + Her own time message (57 shares)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Ruhi and Myra both hold up the same shaadi card on their phones: "Mrs Kapoor ki beti ki shaadi, sabko card aaya!" and Tanya, who did not get one, keeps her eyes on her ticket. Context: the two list every function (haldi, sangeet, reception, 'Maggi counter bhi hai') while Tanya pretends not to care and checks her WhatsApp under the table, chip 'CARDS: 13/14'. Ending: Tanya stands up with the kitty diary: "Agli kitty Shaadi theme, 22 November, full lehenga, sangeet bhi!" and both instantly cut their numbers and shout "Main toh aaungi!"
ideas.format: Housie-in-progress sitcom + phone card screens, theme announcement ending
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Tulsi Vivah 21 Nov opens shaadi season (17 days, +2) + Shaadi season kitty + Admin breaks her own rule shape

ideas.idea: Barf mein sikka: the night before, the host freezes 5 Re 1 coins in water in a small steel katori for every lady. In 3 minutes each lady must free as many coins as she can using only her hands and breath (no hot water, no banging on the floor, no teeth). Crazy twist: every 45 seconds the host shouts "Thand!" and everyone passes her half-melted block to the left, so the slow melters get a head start and the fast ones lose their work. Most coins wins. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes, keep a towel under each katori.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, frozen katori close-up, the Thand pass twist, rules, winner slide
ideas.source: Trend: Coins frozen in ice (venuelook.com) + first cold weeks of November

ideas.idea: Sabse common jawab: the host reads 8 household questions every family shouts at mummy ("Kainchi kahan hai?", "Extra chabi?", "Fevicol?", "Thermometer?") and each lady writes where it is in her own house in 10 seconds. Answers are read out and you score one point for every other lady who wrote the same place, so the most common answer wins. Crazy twist: the last question is "Pati ka chashma kahan hai?" and anyone who writes "unke sir pe" gets 5 bonus points. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes, only paper and pens.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, sample question slips, scoring example, the chashma twist, winner slide
ideas.source: Trend: Tag your Ghar ki Raunak (our reel, 11 shares) + Multi-character debate (fluxnote.io)

ideas.idea: Mandap banao: teams of 4 or 5 get 4 belans or rulers, 4 empty water bottles, a dupatta, rubber bands and a string of marigolds, and have 3 minutes to build a mandap that stands on its own with a small tulsi or plant pot under it, like Tulsi Vivah. Crazy twist: at 2 minutes the host shouts "Baraat late hai!" and takes one item from every team, and the mandap must still stand for 10 seconds when she drops a bangle on top. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, item tray, build in progress, Baraat late twist, winning mandap
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Tulsi Vivah 21 Nov (17 days, +2) + Pack in 60 seconds (timed build with household things)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Ruhi's phone pings and she reads the shaadi group out loud: "Sangeet dress code: magenta! Haldi: dusty rose!" Context: Tanya and Myra count their wardrobes on their fingers, "Magenta toh ek hi hai, woh bhi pichli kitty mein pehna tha," chip 'MAGENTA SAREES: 1' changes as each lady admits a repeat, and they all swear to buy a new one. Ending: at the sangeet the three of them walk in wearing the exact same magenta saree from the same kitty sale, freeze, then pose for one group photo.
ideas.format: Kitty Gang sitcom, Housie table to sangeet hall, 3 characters, Hinglish, under 30 s; caption names 'the friend who buys the same saree'
ideas.source: Trend: Shaadi function colour codes (azafashions.com, Manyavar 2026) + Festival window: shaadi muhurats 21-26 Nov (16 days, +2)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Shruti slams a sugarcane on the table: "20 ko Dev Uthani, 21 ko Tulsi Vivah, is baar kitty mein hi karenge!" Context: Tanya becomes ladkiwale and Myra ladkewale and they haggle like a real rishta over the shagun (ganna, sindoor, one Housie ticket), chip 'SHAGUN' goes up with each demand. Ending: the gang walks the phere around a tulsi pot under a sugarcane mandap, and Myra stops mid-phera: "Pehle Full House do, phir shaadi!"
ideas.format: Kitty Gang sitcom, living room puja corner with tulsi pot, sugarcane mandap, 3 characters, under 30 s
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Dev Uthani 20 Nov + Tulsi Vivah 21 Nov (15-16 days, +2) + Multi-character debate

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Tina cuts a number and announces: "24 ko kitty cancel, sab Gurpurab pe langar seva!" Context: Tanya reads the seva list and every lady dodges her job ("Main sirf roti belungi, bartan nahi"), chip 'SEVA LIST' fills one name at a time. Ending: at the gurudwara kitchen Tanya, Ruhi and Shruti in dupattas roll rotis in a row, and Shruti still calls Housie numbers from her phone between rotis.
ideas.format: Kitty Gang sitcom, Housie table to gurudwara langar kitchen, 3 characters per shot, under 30 s
ideas.source: Trend: Gurpurab langar seva (hindupad.com) + Festival window: Gurpurab 24 Nov (19 days, +2)

ideas.idea: Gol roti: pairs share one belan, each lady holding one end with her left hand only, and get 1 minute to roll a ball of atta into a roti on a chakla; the host lays a steel quarter plate on top and the roti that matches the plate edge best wins. Crazy twist: at 30 seconds the host shouts "Langar mein aur log aa gaye!" and every pair must tear its roti in half and roll two small rotis instead. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes, one plate of atta for the whole group.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, belan held by two hands, twist moment, roti under the plate test, winning pair
ideas.source: Trend: Gurpurab langar seva (hindupad.com) + Festival window: Gurpurab 24 Nov (19 days, +2) + One-minute game

ideas.idea: Dress code dhoondo: the host calls a shaadi function and its colour ("Sangeet, magenta!", "Haldi, peela!", "Mehendi, hara!") and every lady has 10 seconds to hold up something of that colour from her bag, outfit or the room; the last one or anyone without it is out. Crazy twist: on "Rishtedaar aa gaye!" every lady must swap dupattas or stoles with the lady on her right and keep playing in them. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, colour call list, ladies holding up items, dupatta swap twist, winner
ideas.source: Trend: Shaadi function colour codes (azafashions.com) + Festival window: shaadi muhurats 21-26 Nov (16 days, +2)

ideas.idea: Rajai mein kya hai: the host hides 10 household things under a thick rajai on the sofa (comb, lemon, remote, bangle, matchbox, steel spoon, safety pin box, sock, hair clip, tea strainer). Each lady gets 30 seconds to feel through the rajai without lifting it, then writes her list; most right answers wins. Crazy twist: one thing is a zip bag of ice cubes and whoever names it first gets double points, but the host swaps two items while the next lady is feeling. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 to 20 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, rajai on sofa, hands feeling through, answer sheet, the reveal
ideas.source: Trend: Cozy pajama winter kitty + Coins frozen in ice (first cold weeks of November)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Tanya sets a huge kadhai on the table: "Pehli thand, pehla gajar ka halwa!" Context: on every called number Ruhi and Myra argue whose saas makes it better ("Khoya daalo!", "Condensed milk se hi banta hai!") while sneaking extra spoons, chip 'HALWA KATORIS: 14' dropping each beat. Ending: Shruti claims Full House and, offered the cash envelope or the last katori, grabs the katori; Ruhi and Myra stare at the empty kadhai.
ideas.format: Housie-in-progress sitcom, living room, kadhai and katori chip, 3 characters per shot, Hinglish, under 30 s; caption 'Tag the friend jo halwa ke liye kitty bhi chhod de'
ideas.source: Trend: First winter spread: gajar halwa and sarson saag (republicworld.com) + LEARNINGS: open on a game in progress, visible stake chip

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Ruhi leans in and whispers: "Suno, kal society mein jo hua na..." Context: every time she gets to the juicy part something cuts her off (a number she must cut, the chai tray, Shruti's phone ringing), and Tanya and Myra lean closer each time, chip 'GOSSIP: 90% loading'. Ending: she finally opens her mouth and the doorbell rings; the lady she was talking about walks in, and all three loudly cut numbers. Text: 'Part 2?'
ideas.format: Micro-drama style Housie sitcom with a cliffhanger, 3 characters, under 30 s; caption 'Part 2 chahiye? Comment GOSSIP'
ideas.source: Trend: Micro-drama cliffhanger (Meta-Ormax report, 89% feed discovery) + Multi-character debate + real gossip-after-she-leaves scene

ideas.idea: Hook: the first cold kitty at Myra's, Housie running, everyone in shawls, and the one room heater sits next to Tanya's chair. Context: on every called number someone shifts her chair an inch closer (Ruhi with a 'chai garam karni hai' excuse, Shruti with 'ticket dikh nahi raha'), and the heater chip 'HEATER SEAT: Tanya' keeps changing. Ending: Myra, the host, switches the heater off: "Bijli ka bill main bharti hoon," and all three pull their shawls over their heads and keep playing.
ideas.format: Housie-in-progress sitcom, living room with room heater and shawls, musical-chairs drift, 3 characters per shot, under 30 s
ideas.source: Trend: Cozy pajama winter kitty + first cold weeks of November + LEARNINGS: open on the game, stake chip changes every shot

ideas.idea: Thand ka parcel: wrap a small prize in 10 layers, and inside each layer put one winter thing (sock, muffler, monkey cap, gloves, shawl, ear muffs). Pass it to music; when the music stops the holder opens one layer and must wear what she finds for the rest of the game, even a sock on her hand. Crazy twist: when the host shouts "Heater on!" everyone must take off one worn item and put it on the lady to her right. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, the layered parcel, ladies in mismatched winter wear, Heater on twist, winner slide
ideas.source: Trend: Cozy pajama winter kitty + Ugly sweater winter party + first cold weeks of November

ideas.idea: Gossip ki kadi: sit in a circle; the host starts a story with one line ("Kal society mein ek lady ne..."), and each lady must repeat the whole story so far and add one new line in 15 seconds; forget a line or freeze and you are out. Crazy twist: before the game the host gives one secret chit "Story palat do", and that lady must flip the story with a plot twist; at the end everyone guesses who the twister was. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes, only chits.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, sample story chain, the secret chit, guess-the-twister slide, winner
ideas.source: Trend: Micro-drama cliffhanger (Meta-Ormax report) + Multi-character debate (fluxnote.io)

ideas.idea: Thekua stamp: each lady gets a lemon-sized ball of atta dough, a steel plate and one household tool (fork, comb, bottle cap, toothpick) and has 1 minute to press the prettiest Chhath thekua pattern. Crazy twist: at 30 seconds the host shouts "Tool badlo!" and everyone passes her tool to the right and finishes with the new one. The room votes the best design with raised spoons. 8 to 20 ladies in rounds of 5, 10 to 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, dough and tools, the tool swap twist, best patterns, winner slide
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Chhath 15 Nov (9 days, +2) + One-minute game

ideas.idea: Hook: doorbell, Tanya blocks her door holding a register: "Shaadi season shuru, pehle udhaar wapas, phir entry!" Context: each guest arrives and returns what she borrowed for last season's weddings (Ruhi a kundan set, Myra a lehenga in a dry-clean bag, Shruti one jhumka, 'doosra mil jayega'), chip 'RETURNED: 0/3' ticking up each ring. Ending: Myra points at Tanya's ears: the host is wearing Ruhi's earrings, and all three walk past her into the party.
ideas.format: Door arrivals (our winner shape: one rule, one guest per ring, a chip that changes each shot, the rule thrown back at the host), front door set, 3 characters per shot; caption 'Tag your host jo sabse zyada udhaar leti hai'
ideas.source: Trend: Tag your kitty host (our reel, 18 comments on 31 likes) + shaadi dates 21-26 Nov (+2) + LEARNINGS: door-arrivals winner

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Myra's phone pings and she reads the class group aloud: "Kal Children's Day fancy dress, costume compulsory!" Context: on every called number one lady builds a costume for her child from the host's house (Ruhi turns Shruti's dupatta into a Jhansi ki Rani sash, Tanya makes a carrot from the orange cushion cover), chip 'COSTUMES: 0/3'. Ending: next morning the school photos land in the kitty group, three kids in costumes made from Shruti's curtains, and Shruti stares at her bare window.
ideas.format: Housie-in-progress sitcom + phone screen ending, living room, 3 characters per shot, Hinglish, under 30 s; caption 'Tag the friend jiske ghar se costume banta hai'
ideas.source: Trend: Last-minute school fancy dress (Children's Day 14 Nov, 7 days, +2) + recreated real-life panic reels (socialketchup.in)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Tanya waves an envelope: "Sharma ji ki beti ki shaadi, kitty se ek gift jayega, sab 500 do!" Context: on every number the three fight over the gift (Ruhi: dinner set, Myra: chandi ka sikka, Shruti: "Cash do, sabse useful"), chip 'GIFT FUND: Rs 1,500 / 7,000' creeping up. Ending: at the reception they carry a giant dinner set box on stage, and the bride's mother proudly points at the gift table: six identical dinner set boxes.
ideas.format: Housie-in-progress sitcom, living room then reception stage set, money chip every shot, 3 characters per shot; caption 'Aapki kitty mein gift kaun choose karta hai? Tag her'
ideas.source: Trend: Shaadi season kitty + shaadi dates 21-26 Nov (+2) + Housie money fight (real hisaab scene)

ideas.idea: Mehendi lagi hai bangle toss: line up 6 empty water bottles 6 feet away, each labelled with a shaadi function and points (Haldi 10, Mehendi 20, Sangeet 30, Phere 50), and every lady gets 5 glass or plastic bangles to ring the bottle necks. Crazy twist: on the host's shout "Mehendi lagi hai!" the next throw must be made holding the bangle only between two fingertips, palm open, like wet mehendi. Highest score in 3 rounds wins. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card with 'kitty party game for shaadi season' on slide 1, bottle setup with labels, the mehendi-fingers throw, score board, winner
ideas.source: Trend: Household dexterity one-minute games (stylecraze.com) + shaadi dates 21-26 Nov (+2) + Search-friendly saveable carousels

ideas.idea: Arghya walk: each lady holds a steel plate as a soop with 5 fruits (banana, apple, orange, lemon, a sugarcane piece) raised above her head with both hands and walks 10 steps to a dupatta 'ghat' line and back. Crazy twist: at the line the host shouts "Suraj dooba!" and she must kneel, stand up again and add one more fruit from the host's basket without lowering the plate; drop anything and you restart. Fastest clean walk wins. 8 to 20 ladies in rounds of 4, 10 to 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card 'Chhath kitty party game' on slide 1, the fruit soop, the kneel twist, a dropped orange, winner
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window Chhath 15 Nov (8 days, +2) + Household dexterity one-minute games (stylecraze.com)

ideas.idea: Ulte haath ka ABC: Children's Day round; each lady gets a sheet and pencil and has 1 minute to write A to Z with her other hand, neat enough for the host 'teacher' to read. Crazy twist: whenever the host taps a ruler and shouts "Teacher aa gayi!" everyone must pass her sheet to the right and carry on from where the last lady stopped, so every page ends in three handwritings; the room votes the messiest copy for the 'Detention' sash. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 minutes, only paper and pencils.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card 'Children's Day kitty party game' on slide 1, wobbly left-hand letters, the pass twist, the messiest sheet, winner and Detention sash
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window Children's Day 14 Nov (7 days, +2) + Search-friendly saveable carousels

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Tanya bangs the kitty diary: "Naya rule! Shaadi season mein kitty skip ki toh agli baar double kitty!" Context: on every called number one lady checks her shaadi calendar and swallows her excuse (Ruhi: sangeet practice, Myra: mausi ki mehendi, Shruti: 'main toh aaungi'), chip 'SKIP FINE: Rs 0' never moving. Ending: Tanya's own phone rings on speaker, her saas: "Bhaanji ki shaadi 21 ko, Lucknow ki tickets ho gayi", and all three silently hold the kitty pot out to her.
ideas.format: Housie-in-progress sitcom, host breaks her own rule (our 7 Nov winner shape), living room, money chip every shot, 3 characters per shot; caption 'Rule banane wali hi pehle todti hai. Tag your Tanya!'
ideas.source: Trend: Host breaks her own rule + 'Tag your Tanya' (our 7 Nov reel: 2364 views, skip 26.6%, 3 shares) + shaadi dates 21-26 Nov

ideas.idea: Hook: Myra claims Full House and Shruti snaps a photo of her with the Rs 3,000 envelope: "Society group mein daal diya!" Context: Myra's phone pings on every called number, her husband in the family group ("Congrats! Ticket ke paise toh maine diye the"), then her son ("Mummy, PS5?"), then her saas ("Mandir ke liye 500 rakh dena"), chip 'PRIZE LEFT: Rs 3,000' dropping each ping. Ending: at home Myra slips the envelope into the atta dabba, and the camera pulls back to show the dabba is already stuffed with old kitty envelopes.
ideas.format: Housie-in-progress sitcom + phone message screens, living room then kitchen, money chip every shot, 3 characters per shot; caption 'Kitty ka prize kahan chhupati ho? Tag the friend with the atta dabba bank'
ideas.source: Trend: Ticket in the wife's name (Kullu Tambola reel, 840 likes) + Housie money fight

ideas.idea: Hook: kitty over, Ruhi at the host's bed piled with twelve grey shawls: "Meri shawl kaunsi hai?" Context: Tanya, Shruti and Myra each grab one with total confidence ("Meri pe kadhai hai", "Meri lambi hai"), sniff it, swap it, and the chip 'GREY SHAWLS: 12 / OWNERS: 0 sure' never changes. Ending: next kitty, the doorbell rings four times and each lady walks in wearing someone else's shawl, and nobody says a word.
ideas.format: Living-room and front-door sitcom, the chappal-mix-up feeling for winter, one shawl pile prop, 3 characters per shot, under 30 s; caption 'Sardi ki kitty ka asli game. Tag the friend jo aapki shawl le gayi'
ideas.source: Trend: First winter kitty + Cozy pajama winter kitty (shawls on every set this week)

ideas.idea: Shaadi akshar: the host throws a bangle on an A to Z chart to pick a letter, and each lady has 60 seconds to write one shaadi word per category starting with it (a rasam, a sangeet gaana, a menu dish, a jewellery piece, a relative). Unique answers get 2 points, shared ones 1. Crazy twist: to keep her sangeet gaana point each lady must sing one line of it to the room, and a blank or wrong tune loses it. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes, only paper, pens and a bangle.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card 'Shaadi season kitty party game' on slide 1, the A to Z chart and bangle, a sample sheet, the singing twist, winner; caption asks for their answers for one letter
ideas.source: Trend: Same-letter word game (777 likes, 681 comments) + shaadi dates 21-26 Nov

ideas.idea: Salai ka phanda: everyone gets a small ball of wool and two pencils as knitting needles and has 2 minutes to cast on as many stitches as she can; the most even row wins. Crazy twist: every lady who cannot knit is paired with one who can, and the expert may only teach with her hands behind her back while the beginner knits, like mummy teaching over the phone. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes, wool and pencils only.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card 'Sardi ki kitty game' on slide 1, wool and pencils, a hands-behind-the-back teacher, wonky vs neat rows, winner
ideas.source: Trend: First winter kitty + Household dexterity one-minute games

ideas.idea: Joota chupai: the host's chappal is the dulha's joota; one team of saaliyan hides it in the room while the ladkewale team waits outside, then the seekers get 3 minutes to find it while the hiders sing a shaadi song louder as they get closer and softer as they move away. Crazy twist: once found, the finder must haggle the 'neg' with the hiders for 30 seconds with play notes, and the side that gives in first loses the round. 8 to 20 ladies in two teams, 15 to 20 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card 'Shaadi season kitty party game' on slide 1, the hiding team, the loud-soft song clue, the neg haggle with play notes, winning team
ideas.source: Trend: Shaadi season kitty + Shaadi function colour codes, shaadi dates 21-26 Nov (13-18 days away)

ideas.idea: Hook: Tanya reads the kitty group aloud: "Agli kitty theme: nakli shaadi! Dulha dulhan nahi, sirf sangeet!" Context: the gang pulls role chits from a steel katori, everyone hopes for 'dulhan', and each chit opened gets louder groans (bua, halwai, ladkewale). Ending: Shruti opens the last chit, 'dulha', and the final shot is her in a dupatta pagdi with a marigold sehra while Ruhi and Myra dance the baraat around her.
ideas.format: Kitty Gang sitcom, chit-pulling at the host's sofa, role chip that changes every shot, baraat dance ending
ideas.source: Trend: Nakli shaadi party (boldsky.com) + shaadi dates 21-26 Nov (12-17 days away)

ideas.idea: Hook: Myra claims Full House and Ruhi grabs her phone: "Ruko! Light theek nahi thi, ek baar aur claim karo!" Context: on every re-take Ruhi moves the table lamp, asks for slow motion and a 'reaction from Tanya', and the real Housie is stuck on number 47. Ending: Ruhi posts the reel and everyone leans in to watch: Myra is cropped out and only Ruhi's face is in frame.
ideas.format: Kitty Gang sitcom, Housie in progress, phone screen shots of the reel being shot, take counter chip
ideas.source: Trend: Shaadi has become content (theprint.in) + One-claim proof reel

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Shruti cuts a number and says: "Main chaar din Chhath ke liye gaon ja rahi hoon, hisaab Tina ke paas." Context: on every number one lady leans in, not with money, but with an order: "Mere liye do dabba thekua!" and Tina's notebook fills with thekua orders instead of the kitty hisaab. Ending: Shruti reads the list, 37 dabbe, and the last shot is her mother on video call fainting on the bed.
ideas.format: Kitty Gang sitcom, Housie in progress, notebook close-ups with a growing order count chip, video call ending
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window Chhath 13-16 Nov + Housie money fight

ideas.idea: Sehra bandhi: pairs, one is the dulha and sits still, the other has 3 minutes to make a sehra on her head from household things (dupatta, hair clips, paper strips, marigolds, a steel strainer as the crown). Crazy twist: the maker works with one hand only, and the dulha must keep a straight face while the room tries to make her laugh; every laugh costs the pair 15 seconds. Gang votes the best sehra. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Kitty party game for shaadi season' with a half-made sehra and a laughing dulha, the household kit, one-hand rule, laugh penalty, winning pair
ideas.source: Trend: Nakli shaadi party + shaadi dates 21-26 Nov (12-17 days away) + Game carousels stuck under 250 views

ideas.idea: Mungfali guess: each lady takes one fistful of peanuts in their shells from the winter bowl and writes how many dane she thinks are inside. Then everyone gets 1 minute to shell and count. Crazy twist: they shell while wearing a woollen glove on the shelling hand, and every dana dropped on the floor is minus one. The closest guess wins, ties go to the cleanest plate. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 minutes. Swap for chana if anyone has a nut allergy.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Sardi ki kitty party game' with gloved hands shelling, the guess chits, dropped dane, winner with her plate
ideas.source: Trend: First winter spread + Household dexterity one-minute games

ideas.idea: Card yaad hai?: the host shows a made-up shaadi card on her phone for 30 seconds (names of dulha, dulhan, both fathers, venue and four function dates and dress codes), then asks 10 questions and every lady writes her answers. Crazy twist: while the card is on screen, one lady plays 'mausi on the phone' and talks nonstop next to everyone with wrong details. Highest score wins. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes, one phone, pens and paper.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Shaadi season kitty party game' with the card on screen and the mausi chattering, the questions, wrong answers, winner
ideas.source: Trend: Shaadi function colour codes + shaadi dates 21-26 Nov (12-17 days away)

ideas.idea: Hook: doorbell, Tanya blocks her door in a chunky sweater holding the kitty pot: "Sweater kitty! Haath ka buna nahi toh entry nahi!" Context: one guest per ring, Ruhi's has a mall tag, Myra admits her saas knitted half and the market did the rest, Shruti's is her husband's, and the chip 'HAATH KA BUNA: 0/3' never moves while Tanya sends each one to the balcony. Ending: Shruti pulls Tanya's collar straight for the group photo and a big 'SALE Rs 499' tag flips out, and all three walk straight in past her.
ideas.format: Door arrivals, winter rule judged at the front door, a guest per ring, chip that never moves, host breaks her own rule, 25-30 s; caption 'Rule banane wali ka sweater bhi sale wala. Tag your Tanya!'
ideas.source: Trend: Host breaks her own rule + 'Tag your Tanya' (door reels 6031 and 2737 views, skip 26-28%) + First winter kitty + Ugly sweater winter party

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Ruhi back from a shaadi cuts a number: "Kal ki shaadi mein live jalebi, live dosa, aur live Maggi counter tha!" and the gang sings back "Yeh normal hai!" Context: on every called number she lists a stranger counter (paan shots, momos in a silver thaal, a chocolate fountain with gol gappe) and the chorus gets louder, chip 'COUNTERS: 12'. Ending: Myra the host lifts the cloth off today's kitty snacks, a 'live counter' of Parle-G and kettle chai with a paper sign, and the gang sings the chorus one last time, slower.
ideas.format: Musical sitcom: Housie table, whole-gang sung chorus on every trigger (our 44% skip shape), 3 characters per shot, under 30 s; caption 'Har shaadi se lauti ek saheli ka review. Tag the friend jo buffet ki report deti hai'
ideas.source: Trend: 'Yeh normal hai' shaadi buffet (freepressjournal.in) + Sung chorus on a repeating trigger (KG-2026-11-05-a, skip 44.3%) + shaadi dates 21-26 Nov

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running in full lehengas and heavy sets, Tanya taps her watch: "Saat baje reception hai, kitty se seedha wahin!" Context: on every called number something fights back (Ruhi's jhumka hooks her ticket, Myra's bun is pinned so tight she cannot look down to cut, Tanya's dupatta pin stabs the sofa), chip 'RECEPTION IN: 40 min' dropping each shot. Ending: they sweep into the banquet hall and the bride's mother stares at them: "Aap log? Reception toh kal hai!" and Ruhi zooms into the card photo: 22 November.
ideas.format: Kitty Gang sitcom, Housie table then banquet hall entrance, countdown chip every shot, 3 characters per shot, 25-30 s; caption 'Tag the friend jo hamesha ek din pehle taiyaar hoti hai'
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window shaadi dates 21-26 Nov (11-16 days, +2) + Shaadi has become content (theprint.in) + LEARNINGS: open on the game, chip changes every shot

ideas.idea: Baraat freeze: play any baraat song and everyone dances like the groom's friends; when the music stops the host shouts a shaadi pose and the room must form it in 5 seconds with the exact headcount (Varmala = 2, Joota chupai = 3, Phere = 4, Family photo = 6); anyone left over is out. Crazy twist: on "Mascot aa gaya!" the last lady out comes back as the mascot and walks through the dancers in slow motion, and anyone who laughs is out too. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes, only a phone speaker.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Kitty party game for shaadi season' with a frozen Varmala pose and a mascot aunty, pose and headcount list, the mascot twist, last couple standing
ideas.source: Trend: Friends' baraat entry performance (freepressjournal.in) + Mascot entry at the shaadi (thenodmag.com) + shaadi dates 21-26 Nov (11-16 days, +2)

ideas.idea: Tulsi Vivah thaal, by touch: each team's blindfolded lady must fill a steel thaal with the 7 Tulsi Vivah things (sugarcane piece, red chunri, haldi, sindoor dibbi, amla, shakarkandi, diya) from a tray of 20 things, guided only by her team's voices. Crazy twist: the tray is full of look-alike decoys by touch (aloo for shakarkandi, lemon and ber for amla, a lipstick for the sindoor dibbi), and every decoy in the thaal costs 2 points. Fastest clean thaal in 2 minutes wins. 8 to 20 ladies in teams of 4, 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Tulsi Vivah kitty party game' with a blindfolded lady holding an aloo, the 7-item list, the decoy tray, a wrong thaal, winners
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window Tulsi Vivah 21 Nov (11 days, +2) + Household dexterity one-minute games

ideas.idea: Ek sweater, poori kitty: the host brings one big old cardigan with buttons; in a relay, each lady must put it on, button every button, say "Mummy, ab thand nahi lag rahi!", unbutton, take it off and pass it on. Crazy twist: when the host shouts "Ulta!" the next lady must wear it inside out and back to front, and when she shouts "Monkey cap!" she also pulls on a cap and keeps it for the rest of her turn. Fastest team wins. 8 to 20 ladies in two teams, 10 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Sardi ki kitty party game' with a lady in a back-to-front cardigan mid-button, the relay line, the Ulta twist, winning team
ideas.source: Trend: First winter kitty + Ugly sweater winter party + Household dexterity one-minute games

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Ruhi leans into the lens and whispers: "Shruti ka phone band hai... aur kitty ka paisa usi ke paas hai." chip 'POT: Rs 28,000 · SHRUTI: OFFLINE'. Context: on every called number Tanya and Myra add one wilder theory (Goa ticket, new gold set, 'cousin ka business'), each with a phone screen as proof that turns out to be something else. Ending: Shruti bursts in with the envelope and an FD receipt: "Bank mein daal diya, saat percent!" and all three shout together: "Humse poocha?!"
ideas.format: Whisper-hook Housie sitcom, theory chip changes every shot
ideas.source: Trend: Whisper secret hook (TH-2026-11-10, skip 55.8%) + Who holds the kitty money (4800 likes)

ideas.idea: Hook: day-after-sangeet kitty, Housie running, Tanya, Ruhi and Myra sit with both palms of wet mehendi held up: "Ticket kaun katega?" Context: Shruti, the only one without mehendi, cuts all three tickets as they shout numbers at her, chip 'TICKETS: 4 · HAATH: 2'. Ending: Shruti claims Full House, then stares: she cut all the numbers on Myra's ticket, and Myra wins without lifting a finger, mehendi palms up in a victory pose.
ideas.format: Housie-in-progress sitcom, shaadi season
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window shaadi dates 21-26 Nov (10-15 days, +2) + Shaadi function colour codes

ideas.idea: Hook: doorbell, Tanya blocks her door in a red saree holding the kitty pot: "Fire and ice kitty! Laal ya safed, beech ka nahi chalega!" Context: one guest per ring, chip 'TEAM AAG: 1 · TEAM BARF: 0', Ruhi in white wins ice, Myra flips her shawl to switch to the winning side, Shruti arrives in pink and argues it is 'halki aag'. Ending: Tanya's own ice block centrepiece has melted into a puddle at her feet and the gang points: "Team barf toh tumhari hi doob gayi!"
ideas.format: Door-arrivals (rule + one guest per ring + host breaks her own rule)
ideas.source: Trend: Fire and ice theme kitty (partystuff.in) + Host breaks her own rule (door reels 6031 and 2716 views)

ideas.idea: Geeli mehendi challenge: each lady wears a pair of socks on her hands as 'wet mehendi' and in 1 minute must unwrap a toffee, open a safety pin and pin her dupatta, and cut 3 numbers on a Housie ticket with a pen. Crazy twist: when the host shouts "Mehendi kharab!" everyone must freeze palms up for 5 seconds, and anyone who touches anything starts again. 8 to 20 ladies in rounds of 4, 10 to 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Shaadi season kitty game' with a lady in socks on her hands fighting a toffee wrapper, the 3 tasks, the freeze twist, the winner
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window shaadi dates 21-26 Nov (10-15 days, +2) + Household dexterity one-minute games

ideas.idea: Kitty ka hisaab: the host reads a fast running kitty hisaab aloud once ("Ruhi ne 2000 diye, Myra ke 500 pending, cake 650, Shruti ne 1000 diye...") and every lady writes the final balance on paper with no calculator. Crazy twist: halfway through, the host stops and asks 'Kiske kitne pending hain?' and pending ladies must answer before she continues; the closest final number wins the bonus chit. 8 to 20 ladies, 3 rounds, 10 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Kitty hisaab game, calculator mana hai' with a lady scribbling sums, the read-aloud list, the twist, the answer slide
ideas.source: Trend: Who holds the kitty money (4800 likes) + Housie money fight

ideas.idea: Aag aur barf: chairs in a circle, one less than the players, half covered with a red dupatta and half with a white one. Play music; when it stops the host shouts "Aag!" or "Barf!" and ladies may only sit on that colour, and anyone left standing is out. Crazy twist: on "Toofan!" everyone must swap shawl or dupatta with the lady on her right before she sits. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Winter kitty game: Aag aur barf' with a lady mid-dive onto a red chair, the setup, the colour call, the Toofan twist
ideas.source: Trend: Fire and ice theme kitty (partystuff.in) + First winter kitty

ideas.idea: Hook: doorbell, Tanya blocks her door with both palms covered elbow-deep in mehendi: "Shaadi season kitty! Full haath mehendi nahi toh entry nahi!" Context: one guest per ring, Ruhi shows one tiny dot ('minimal hai, trend hai!'), Myra has mehendi on one hand only ('doosre se khana banaya'), Shruti's sticker mehendi peels off as she waves, chip 'FULL MEHENDI: 0/3' never moving while Tanya points each one to the balcony. Ending: Shruti grabs Tanya's palm to admire it and her thumb comes away blue: it is ballpoint pen, and all three walk straight in past her.
ideas.format: Door arrivals, shaadi season rule at the front door, one guest per ring, chip that never moves, host breaks her own rule, 25-30 s; caption 'Rule banane wali ki mehendi bhi pen wali. Tag your Tanya!'
ideas.source: Trend: Minimal mehendi vs full haath (shaadiwish.com) + Door-arrivals holds with a new host (skip 27.2%) + Festival window shaadi dates 21-26 Nov (9-14 days, +2)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Myra rushes in 40 minutes late, phone at her ear: "Haan, daal mein namak daal diya hai..." Context: on every called number her phone rings again (son: 'mera moza?', husband: 'charger kahan hai?', saas: 'dawai ka time') and Tanya, Ruhi and Shruti grab the phone and answer each one for her on speaker, chip 'CALLS: 4 · MYRA KE NUMBER: 0 kate'. Ending: Tanya puts the phone on airplane mode inside the kitty pot, Myra finally cuts her first number, and Ruhi says to the lens: "Mahine mein ek din, sirf apna."
ideas.format: Housie-in-progress sitcom + calls from home, warm ending line, call counter chip every shot, 3 characters per shot, 25-30 s; caption 'Tag the friend jiska phone kitty mein bhi bajta rehta hai'
ideas.source: Trend: Her own time line gets shares (our reel, 13 shares on 130 reach) + LEARNINGS: name a friend type and a rule every group has

ideas.idea: Hook: first winter kitty on Tanya's terrace, Housie running, she pats a chair in the sun: "Dhoop wali kitty!" Context: on every called number the sun patch slides along the floor and Ruhi, Myra and Shruti drag their chairs, the snacks and the Housie board after it, chip 'DHOOP MEIN: 3 chairs · LADIES: 4' as one lady is always left in the shade. Ending: the sun drops behind the water tank and the last shot is all four squeezed under one rajai on one charpai, tickets poking out, still playing.
ideas.format: Kitty Gang sitcom, terrace set with charpai, chairs and water tank, chip changes every shot, 3 characters per shot, under 30 s; caption 'Sardi ki kitty ka asli seating plan. Tag your dhoop wali friend'
ideas.source: Trend: First winter kitty + First winter spread (shawls and rajai on every set this month) + LEARNINGS: open on the game, chip changes every shot

ideas.idea: Varmala ki unchai: teams of 4, one lady is the dulha and two are her 'dost' who hold her elbows; the dulhan gets a dupatta garland and 30 seconds to put it over the dulha's head while the dulha leans back and lifts her chin (feet stay planted, no hands). Crazy twist: the dulhan's team may bribe the dost with a toffee or a Housie ticket, and a bribed dost must let go of the elbow at once. Each garland that lands is a point; swap roles and play again. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes, dupattas and toffees only.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Shaadi season kitty party game' with a dulha leaning back and a dulhan on tiptoe, the setup, the toffee bribe twist, the garland landing, winning team
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window shaadi dates 21-26 Nov (9-14 days, +2) + Friends' baraat entry performance

ideas.idea: Mera ek din: each lady writes on a chit what she would do with one free day with no family duties and folds it into the kitty pot. The host reads them out one by one and everyone writes who they think wrote it; most right guesses wins. Crazy twist: the host slips in two fake chits written 'as the husband' ('main bhi ek din chhutti lunga... aur khaana kaun banayega?') and anyone who guesses a real lady for a fake chit loses a point. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes, chits and pens only.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Kitty party game: ek din sirf apna' with a lady reading a chit and the room laughing, sample chits, the fake husband chit, the score sheet, winner
ideas.source: Trend: Her own time line gets shares (our reel, 13 shares on 130 reach) + Guess who's who caption

ideas.idea: Moze ki jodi: the host empties a laundry bag of 40 mixed family socks (kids, husband, school, woollen) onto a sheet, and each lady has 1 minute to make as many matching pairs as she can, each rolled into the mummy fold ball. Crazy twist: halfway the host shouts "School ka moza missing!" and everyone must drop one finished pair back into the pile; unrolled or wrong pairs count zero. Most correct balls wins. 8 to 20 ladies in rounds of 4, 10 to 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Sardi ki kitty party game' with a lady buried in a sock pile, the rules, the missing-sock twist, a wrong pair caught, the winner's ball pile
ideas.source: Trend: Household dexterity one-minute games (stylecraze.com, venuelook.com) + First winter kitty

ideas.idea: Hook: doorbell, Myra blocks her door holding the kitty pot: "Is baar kitty cash mein! Cash nahi toh entry nahi!" Context: one guest per ring, chip 'CASH: Rs 0 · UPI: 1', Ruhi waves her phone "GPay kar doon?", Shruti pours out her son's gullak in coins, Tina offers a cheque. Ending: the sabziwala rings and Myra turns to the gang: "Kisi ke paas UPI hai? Mere paas chhutta nahi!" and they all hold up their phones.
ideas.format: Door-arrivals (25-30 s), Myra as host who breaks her own rule; caption 'Har group mein ek host hoti hai jo rule banati hai... Tag your Myra!'
ideas.source: Trend: Door-arrivals holds with a new host (skip 27.2%) + Who holds the kitty money

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Shruti looks into the lens: "Mahine mein ek din main sirf Shruti hoon." and flips her buzzing phone face down. Context: on every called number it buzzes again and Ruhi peeks at the name (Beta, Mummy ji, Ji, Beta again), chip 'MISSED CALLS: 1...7', Shruti keeps cutting numbers. Ending: she shouts Full House, flips the phone, types "Kitty jeet gayi. Khaana Swiggy se." and Ruhi and Myra cheer.
ideas.format: Sitcom with a to-camera first line (25 s); caption 'Tag the one whose phone goes ulta at kitty!'
ideas.source: Trend: One confident line to camera holds the hook (skip 31.8%, 8 shares) + Her own time line gets shares + Homemaking routine as content

ideas.idea: Hook: 4 pm winter kitty, Housie running, Tanya: "Har sardi ki kitty mein yeh 4 ladies hoti hain." Context: on every called number one type: Myra in three shawls who never shows her saree, Ruhi in a sleeveless blouse 'saree dikhni chahiye' shivering, Tina parked by the only heater, Shruti who brought gajar halwa and wants credit for every bite. Ending: Ruhi wins Full House, stands up shaking, and all three throw their shawls over her.
ideas.format: Types-of (25-30 s, one type per number, chip 'SHAWLS: 3 · SLEEVELESS: 1'); caption 'Aap kaunsi type ho? Tag your sleeveless wali!'
ideas.source: Trend: First winter kitty + LEARNINGS 2026-11-09 asks for types-of as the next test

ideas.idea: Chhutte paise: the host puts a steel plate of mixed coins (Re 1, 2, 5, 10) in front of each pair and calls an amount ("Rs 47!"); the first pair to slide exactly that amount into the kitty katori, using one hand each, wins the round. Crazy twist: whenever the host shouts "UPI down!" every pair passes its plate to the left and starts again on a new pile. 8 to 20 ladies in pairs, 10 to 15 minutes, coins and katoris only.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Kitty party game: chhutte hain?' with two ladies racing over a coin plate, the rules, the UPI down twist, a wrong count caught, the winners
ideas.source: Trend: Who holds the kitty money + Household dexterity one-minute games

ideas.idea: Matar chheelo: each lady gets an equal heap of winter pea pods on a newspaper and 2 minutes to shell them into her katori; the host weighs or counts by the spoon and the fullest katori wins. Crazy twist: every time the host shouts "Saasu maa aa gayi!" everyone must keep shelling with one hand while folding the newspaper neatly with the other, and any pea on the floor costs a spoon. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes, peas cooked into the kitty snack after.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Sardi ki kitty party game' with a row of ladies racing over pea heaps, the rules, the saasu maa twist, the katori line-up, the winner
ideas.source: Trend: First winter kitty + Homemaking routine as content (chores as the game)

ideas.idea: Sangeet ki practice: the host shows an 8-step shaadi dance once (thumka, bulb lagao, patang udao, matki, ghoonghat, chutki, gol ghoomo, namaste) and teams of 4 must repeat it in sync to any shaadi song; the most in-sync team wins. Crazy twist: whenever the host shouts "Mamaji aa gaye!" the left-most lady must add one new step of her own and the whole team must keep it in every round after. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes, a phone speaker only.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Shaadi season kitty party game' with a team mid-thumka, the 8 steps as icons, the Mamaji twist, the judging, the winning team
ideas.source: Trend: Friends' baraat entry performance + shaadi dates 21-26 Nov (+2)

ideas.idea: Hook: shaadi pheras, Ruhi in the guests' row with her phone hidden in her dupatta, whispering: "Bas ek number aur!" chip 'PHERA 1/7 · TICKET: 12 KATE'. Context: the kitty's online Housie round is live; on every phera the chip moves, Tanya beside her keeps elbowing her ("Mamiji dekh rahi hain!") and Myra leans in to check her ticket instead of stopping her. Ending: on the seventh phera Ruhi jumps up: "Full House!", the whole mandap turns, and the dulhan herself lifts her phone from her lehenga: she was in the round too.
ideas.format: Sitcom with a counting chip (25-30 s), max 3 ladies per shot; caption 'Har shaadi mein ek saheli hoti hai jo Housie nahi chhodti. Tag her!'
ideas.source: Trend: Phone game during the shaadi rasam (thekashmirmonitor.net) + shaadi dates 21-26 Nov (7-12 days, +2)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Shruti opens the kitty diary: "Is mahine ka hisaab... loading." chip 'HISAAB: 10%'. Context: on every called number one lady remembers something pending (Myra's 500, the cake 650, the didi's tip, Tina's UPI that 'failed') and the chip climbs 40%, 70%, 99% while Shruti scribbles faster. Ending: at 99% Tanya says softly "Mera bhi 200 baaki hai...", the chip snaps to 0%, and Shruti shuts the diary: "Agle mahine."
ideas.format: Meme-format progress chip (25 s), Shruti as hisaab-keeper; caption 'Har group mein ek Shruti hoti hai jiska hisaab kabhi 100% nahi hota. Tag your Shruti!'
ideas.source: Trend: Progress chip that climbs and resets (KG-2026-11-07-a: 1891 views, skip 35.6%) + Who holds the kitty money

ideas.idea: Hook: doorbell, but Tanya, Ruhi and Shruti are standing OUTSIDE Myra's locked door with the kitty pot, calling her: "Host tum ho, aur tum hi gayab?" Myra: "Bas do minute, gate pe hoon!" Hard cut to her live location. Context: on every shot the dot jumps to a new shaadi-season errand (parlour, tailor for the blouse, halwai for samosas) while the gang sits on the stairs and starts Housie on the doormat. Ending: Myra runs up with a fresh blow-dry, the blouse and a box of samosas, and Tanya blocks her own door: "Late aayi toh entry nahi!"
ideas.format: Map-journey into door-arrivals flip (25-30 s), Myra as host; caption 'Tag the host jo apni hi kitty mein late aati hai!'
ideas.source: Trend: Live location dot as the middle (KG-2026-11-09-a, skip 40%) + Door-arrivals holds with a new host + shaadi dates 21-26 Nov (+2)

ideas.idea: Katori Housie: a normal fast Housie round, but every lady plays with an empty steel katori balanced on her head; if it falls, her ticket with all its marks passes to the lady on her right. Crazy twist: whenever the host calls "Baraat aa gayi!" everyone must stand, do three thumkas and sit again, katori still on. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes, Housie tickets and steel katoris.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Shaadi season kitty party game' with a lady mid-thumka and the katori wobbling, the rules, the baraat twist, the ticket hand-off, the winner
ideas.source: Trend: Friends' baraat entry performance + Household dexterity one-minute games + shaadi dates 21-26 Nov (+2)

ideas.idea: Main kahan hoon?: each lady in turn picks a chit with a place every kitty lady runs to (sabzi mandi, parlour, tailor, school PTM, shaadi hall, bank queue, doodh dairy) and has 30 seconds to make only its sounds, no words, while the room guesses; she and the first right guesser both score. Crazy twist: when the host shouts "Location share!" the guesser must also act the sound back before the point counts. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes, paper chits only.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Kitty party game: guess her live location' with a lady mooing for the doodh dairy, the chit list, the rules, the Location share twist, the winner
ideas.source: Trend: Live location dot as the middle (our map reel, skip 40%) + Search-friendly saveable carousels

ideas.idea: Chhakka phere: teams of 4 to 5 sit around one chair with a ludo die on a steel plate; two ladies are the dulha-dulhan holding the ends of a dupatta, and the others roll in turn; every six lets the pair take one phera around the chair, and the first pair to finish 7 phere wins. Crazy twist: on a one, the dulhan must stop and do a 5-second bidaai cry ("Mummy!") before her team can roll again. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes, a die, a dupatta and chairs.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Shaadi season kitty party game' with a pair mid-phera and a six on the plate, the setup, the bidaai twist, scoring, the winning jodi
ideas.source: Trend: Phone game during the shaadi rasam (ludo at the pheras) + shaadi dates 21-26 Nov (7-12 days, +2)

ideas.idea: Hook: day after a shaadi, Housie running, Ruhi cuts a number: "1100 ka lifafa diya, toh 1100 ka khaya bhi!" chip 'SHAGUN VASOOL: 20%'. Context: on every called number one lady adds what she ate (Shruti: two rounds of chaat, Myra: live jalebi plus kulfi, Ruhi: paan and a packed dessert box) and the chip climbs 60%, 90%, 100%. Ending: Tanya, quiet till now, says "Maine toh 501 diya tha... aur teen baar dinner kiya", the chip jumps to 'VASOOL: 300%' and all three turn to stare at her.
ideas.format: Meme-format progress chip (25-30 s), max 3 ladies per shot; caption 'Har group mein ek Tanya hoti hai jiska shagun kam aur plate bhaari. Tag your Tanya!'
ideas.source: Trend: Shagun vs the plate hisaab (republicworld.com) + Progress chip that climbs and resets (KG-2026-11-07-a, skip 35.6%) + shaadi dates 24-26 Nov (9-11 days, +2)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Myra's teenage daughter crosses the living room filming the week's trending dance on her phone; Tanya puts down her ticket: "Yeh trend hum karenge." Context: between called numbers the gang copies the steps in sarees while Shruti keeps calling, a chip counts 'TAKE 1, TAKE 2, TAKE 3' and each take breaks on a real kitty thing (pallu slips, a number Ruhi needs, a call from home). Ending: take 4 is perfect, the daughter watches the replay with her mouth open and asks "Mummy, kitty mein meri entry ho sakti hai?"
ideas.format: Sitcom with a take counter (25-30 s), Tanya, Ruhi, Shruti in frame plus the daughter as a walk-on; caption 'Trend bachchon ka, perfect take mummy logon ka. Tag your kitty gang!'
ideas.source: Trend: Elders take over the Gen Z trend (freepressjournal.in) + Group lip-sync throwback

ideas.idea: Hook: Dev Deepawali kitty on Tanya's balcony, Housie running, she points at a full parapet of diyas: "Kartik Purnima hai, 101 diye, ek bhi nahi bujhega!" chip 'DIYE: 101'. Context: on every called number the winter breeze takes a row out (101, 64, 23) while Ruhi and Myra relight with one matchbox and Shruti cuts their tickets for them. Ending: at 'DIYE: 3' Myra runs in with a box of leftover Diwali LED diyas: "Diwali ka stock!", the chip jumps back to 101 and the breeze blows out the last real one.
ideas.format: Sitcom with a counting chip (25 s), balcony set at dusk with diyas and shawls, max 3 per shot; caption 'Har kitty mein ek Myra hoti hai jiske paas Diwali ka stock abhi bhi hai. Tag her!'
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window, Dev Deepawali and Kartik Purnima 24 Nov (9 days, +2) + Progress chip that climbs and resets

ideas.idea: Hisaab barabar: every lady gets 5 paper notes of 'Rs 100' and a chit with two debts ("Tumne Ruhi se 200 liye", "Shruti ko 100 dene hain"); in 3 minutes the whole room must find each other and settle up, and every lady whose wallet ends at the exact amount on the host's master list wins a point. Crazy twist: every 30 seconds the host rings a bell and shouts "Naya kharcha!" (cake, didi ki tip, gift) and each lady must pay the host Rs 100 on the spot, breaking every sum. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes, paper notes and chits only.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Kitty party game: kiska udhaar kiske paas?' with ladies waving paper notes, the chit examples, the rules, the Naya kharcha twist, the winner
ideas.source: Trend: Door-arrivals third win: a money rule (KG-2026-11-09-b, skip 26.3%) + Who holds the kitty money

ideas.idea: Rajai ka cover: rounds of 3 pairs, each pair gets one rajai or dohar and its empty cover and has 2 minutes to get it fully in, corners matched and zip or buttons closed, then hold it up shaking for the host to check. Crazy twist: halfway the host shouts "Mehmaan aa gaye!" and the pair must stop, fold whatever they have into a neat square on the sofa, then unfold and carry on. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes, 3 quilts or dohars with covers.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Winter kitty party game: rajai mein cover chadhao' with one lady fully inside the cover holding the corners, setup, rules, the Mehmaan twist, the winning jodi
ideas.source: Trend: Homemaking routine as content + First winter spread + Household dexterity one-minute games

ideas.idea: Trend ya throwback: the host plays 5 seconds of a song on her phone, a current reel trend or an old Bollywood hit; two teams race to shout "Trend!" or "Throwback!" and then sing the next line, a point for each. Crazy twist: when the host shouts "Beti bulao!" the next lady in the team must do that trend's hook step on the spot, and the other team judges with a thumbs up or down. 8 to 20 ladies in 2 teams, 15 minutes, one phone and a speaker.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Kitty party game: trend hai ya 90s?' with a lady in a saree mid-hook-step, how to play, the Beti bulao twist, scoring, the winning team
ideas.source: Trend: Elders take over the Gen Z trend (freepressjournal.in) + Retro Bollywood audio

ideas.idea: Hook: doorbell, Tanya blocks her door with a steel dabba and points at the wall clock: "4 baje ki kitty! Har minute late, 10 rupaye fine!" chip 'FINE BOX: Rs 0'. Context: one guest per ring with a real excuse (shaadi se seedha, maid nahi aayi, beta ki tuition), each drops coins in and the chip climbs Rs 50, 120, 300. Ending: the last ring is the delivery boy with Tanya's own cake, an hour late, and Ruhi, Myra and Shruti hold out the dabba: "Host ka cake bhi late! Fine bharo!"
ideas.format: Door-arrivals (25-28 s), dressed front door with wall clock and shoe rack, max 3 per shot, a fine chip that changes every ring, host breaks her own rule; caption 'Har group mein ek Tanya hoti hai jo late fine lagati hai aur khud late hoti hai. Tag her!'
ideas.source: Trend: Door-arrivals third win: a money rule (skip 26.3%) + Host breaks her own rule; next door rule should be one viewers forward (late)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Myra slaps her ticket down: "December ki kitty meri pakki, bachchon ke pre-boards se pehle!" chip 'ATTENDANCE: 8/8'. Context: on every called number one lady's phone rings from home ("Mummy, practical file kahan hai?", "Beta ko maths padha do") and she leaves, the chip drops 6, 4, 2.
