Ending: only Myra is left with her son on video call propped on the cage, quizzing him on tables between numbers, and she shouts "Full house!" as he shouts "Saat aathe chhappan!"
ideas.format: Types-of with one stake chip (25 s), living room with Housie cage and kids' books spilling onto the table, max 3 per shot; caption 'Exam season mein kitty = attendance 2/8. Tag the friend jiske ghar boards hain!'
ideas.source: Trend: Types-of with one stake chip (KG-2026-11-10-a, skip 33.3%) + Festival window (December pre-boards)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Ruhi's phone buzzes and her saas is on video call: "Kitty mein kaun kaun hai? Dikhao!" Context: seen from the saas's screen, the phone passes hand to hand round the circle, each lady fixes her pallu and says "Namaste aunty!" while hiding her ticket and her plate, and Tanya keeps calling numbers in the background. Ending: the saas spots the ticket in Shruti's lap: "Ruko! Mera bhi ek ticket kaato!" and the phone ends up propped on the cage, the saas calling the next number herself.
ideas.format: Phone-screen POV sitcom (25 s): the video call frame is the camera as it travels the room, dressed living room, max 3 faces per shot, a call timer chip; caption 'Har kitty mein ek saas ka video call aata hai. Tag your Ruhi!'
ideas.source: Trend: The phone is the camera and travels (theprint.in, 138M views) + calls from home

ideas.idea: Shaadi word Housie: every lady draws a 3x3 grid on paper and fills it with any 9 words from a list of 20 the host reads out (mehendi, sehra, varmala, shagun, baraat, dhol, phera, bidaai, haldi, juta chupai...). The host does not call words, she acts each one in 5 seconds and ladies cut it when they get it; first line, then full grid wins. Crazy twist: whenever the host shouts "Fufaji naraz!" everyone must pass her sheet to the lady on her left and keep playing on it. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes, paper and pens.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Naya Housie: Shaadi Word Housie!' with a lady acting 'sehra' over a paper grid, the word list, how to play, the Fufaji naraz twist, winners; last slide 'Comment SHAADI for the word list'
ideas.source: Trend: Named Housie variant with a comment keyword (1564 likes, 156 comments) + shaadi season

ideas.idea: Dastane mein sui: each lady wears a pair of woollen gloves or socks on her hands and gets a big sewing needle and a 30 cm thread; 1 minute to thread it and sew one button onto a scrap of cloth. Crazy twist: halfway the host shouts "Light gayi!" and switches off the lights for 10 seconds while everyone must keep going, and anyone caught taking a glove off is out. 8 to 20 ladies in rounds of 4, 15 minutes, gloves, big needles with blunt tips, buttons, cloth scraps.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Winter kitty game: gloves pehen ke sui dhaaga!' with a lady squinting at a needle in woollen gloves, what you need, how to play, the light gayi twist, the winner
ideas.source: Trend: First winter kitty + Household dexterity one-minute games

ideas.idea: Board exam ka paper: the host hands each lady a 10-question paper from her kids' schoolbooks (tables, state capitals, one English spelling, one Hindi muhavara, one map dot) and gives 3 minutes; papers are checked by the lady on the right with a red pen and marks read out like a result. Crazy twist: at 90 seconds the host rings a steel glass and shouts "Beta ka phone!" and everyone must swap papers and finish on her neighbour's answers. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes, printed or handwritten papers, pens, one red pen per pair.
ideas.format: Carousel: slide 1 'Kitty mein board exam! Kitne number aayenge?' with a lady chewing a pen over a test paper, sample questions, how to play, the Beta ka phone twist, the topper
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window (December pre-boards) + calls from home

ideas.idea: Hook: doorbell, Tanya blocks her door with a ladle: "Potluck kitty! Sirf ghar ka bana khana, order kiya toh entry nahi!" chip 'GHAR KA KHANA: 0/3'. Context: one guest per ring, Ruhi's 'homemade' chhole come in a steel dabba with the restaurant bill stuck under the lid, Myra's gajar halwa still has the halwai's sticker, Shruti swears she made the dahi vada and her phone pings 'Your order has been delivered', and Tanya sends each one to the balcony. Ending: Shruti slips past into the kitchen, lifts the lid on Tanya's dum aloo and finds the restaurant's foil tray sitting inside the kadhai, and all three walk in holding their dabbas high.
ideas.format: door-arrivals, one guest per ring, chip moves every shot, 25-30 s, max 3 characters per shot, caption 'Tag the friend jiska ghar ka khana restaurant se aata hai!'
ideas.source: Trend: Door-arrivals third win: a money rule (skip 26.3%) + Host breaks her own rule + Nominate-your-friend call gets shares (8 shares)

ideas.idea: Hook: Shruti, the quiet one, looks into the lens during Housie: "Pehle main host ki har baat ek kaan se sunti thi..." chip 'JAWAB: 0'. Context: Tanya announces new rules one by one (ticket Rs 100 se 200, kitty 3 baje, gift minimum Rs 500) and each time Shruti calmly answers with the hisaab from the kitty diary, the gang nods along and the chip climbs 1, 2, 3. Ending: Tanya hands her the diary: "Itna hisaab aata hai toh agle saal ki host tum!" and Shruti pulls her dupatta over one ear and goes back to cutting numbers.
ideas.format: meme-format with a climbing chip, one line to camera then Housie table shots, 25-30 s, max 3 characters per shot, caption 'Tag the friend jo ab chup nahi rehti!'
ideas.source: Trend: Pehle chup, ab jawab: answer-back voiceover (freepressjournal.in, about 45.6K reels) + Who holds the kitty money

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Tanya holds up her phone: "Kitty ka apna page banayenge! Creator kaun banegi?" chip 'FOLLOWERS: 0'. Context: each type pitches and films one try: Ruhi's gossip podcast (cut off mid-name), Myra's halwa recipe reel (the halwa catches), Shruti's Housie live (only her mummy joins), and the chip barely moves 3, 7, 12. Ending: the clip that blows up is the one nobody planned, Tanya in the background shouting "Yeh Full House galat hai!", the chip jumps to '10K', and Tanya snatches the phone: "Creator main hoon."
ideas.format: types-of with one stake chip, each type a reply to Tanya, 25-30 s, max 3 characters per shot, caption 'Aapki kitty ki creator kaun? Tag karo!'
ideas.source: Trend: Nominate-your-friend call gets shares (our Top 100 creator reel: 1763 views, 9 saves, 8 shares) + Types-of with one stake chip (skip 33.3%)

ideas.idea: Peela dhoondo: teams of 4 or 5; the host calls a yellow thing (haldi, nimbu, kela, a yellow bangle, a yellow dupatta, a pencil) and the first team to bring it from their handbags or the kitchen to the host's table scores. Crazy twist: whenever the host shouts "Nazar lag gayi!" every team must also bring one black thing (kajal, a hairband, a black bindi) before the yellow one counts. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes, only what is already in the house and the handbags.
ideas.format: Kitty Game Ideas carousel: hook slide, setup, 3 rule slides, twist slide, comment ask 'Aapke purse mein sabse ajeeb peeli cheez kya hai?'
ideas.source: Trend: Yellow is the shaadi colour of 2026 (azafashions.com) + Household dexterity one-minute games

ideas.idea: Kitty awards: the host reads 8 award titles one by one (sabse late, gossip ki rani, hisaab mein kamzor, selfie queen, 'main toh nahi khaungi' wali) and every lady writes one name per award on a chit; the most-named lady wins each award. Crazy twist: each winner must give a 10-second filmy acceptance speech, and if she laughs or says 'main nahi hoon', the award passes to the lady who nominated her. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes, chits, pens and paper sashes.
ideas.format: Kitty Game Ideas carousel ending on 'Aapki kitty mein sabse late kaun? Tag karo!'
ideas.source: Trend: Nominate-your-friend call gets shares (our Top 100 creator reel: 20 comments, 8 shares)

ideas.idea: Jawab hazir: the host reads the taunts every kitty lady hears ("Itni der se aayi?", "Phir wahi saree?", "Diet kab se?", "Ghar pe khana kaun banayega?") and the lady in the hot seat has 5 seconds to answer back with one line; the room claps and the loudest clap scores. Crazy twist: on "Saasu maa mode!" she must answer back just as sharply but in the sweetest, softest voice, and any raised voice is a zero. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes, chits only.
ideas.format: Kitty Game Ideas carousel with example taunt slides and a comment ask 'Aapko sabse zyada kaunsa taunt milta hai?'
ideas.source: Trend: Pehle chup, ab jawab: answer-back voiceover (freepressjournal.in) + Her own time line gets shares

ideas.idea: Hook: doorbell, Tanya blocks her door holding a steel dabba of folded chits: "December kitty ka Secret Santa! Chit uthao, naam kisi ko mat batana, warna entry nahi!" chip 'SECRET: 3/3'. Context: one guest per ring, each picks a chit and gives it away at once (Ruhi gasps and stares at Tanya, Myra whispers it to Shruti, Shruti's face says it all), the chip dropping 2, 1, 0 while Tanya points each one to the balcony. Ending: Tanya picks the last chit for herself, reads it and squeals "Ruhi! Ruhi ko kya doon?", and all three walk straight in past her.
ideas.format: Door arrivals (25-28 s), host breaks her own rule, dressed front door with a small Christmas star on the door, max 3 per shot, a secret chip that drops every ring; caption 'Har kitty mein ek Tanya hoti hai jo Secret Santa ka secret khud kholti hai. Tag her!'
ideas.source: Trend: Secret Santa with a twist (surfoffice.com) + Door-arrivals is our winner (skip 26-34%) + Festival window: December kitty planning

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Myra lays three shaadi cards on the table, all for 3 December, and says "Teen shaadi, ek shaam, aur kitty bhi!" chip 'SHAGUN: Rs 0'. Context: the gang follows her live location dot on Ruhi's phone between Housie numbers: hall 1 (one photo with the dulhan, lifafa, run), hall 2 (lifafa, no food), hall 3 (stuck at the gate behind a baraat), the chip climbing Rs 1100, 2200, 3300 spent. Ending: the dot stops at the kitty door and Myra runs in just as Ruhi, who has been cutting Myra's ticket for her, shouts "Myra ka Full House!", and Myra holds up the prize envelope: "Shagun wapas!"
ideas.format: Map journey (25-30 s): live location dot vs the gang at the Housie table, ending in a door flip, money chip every shot, max 3 per shot; caption 'Ek shaam mein teen shaadi karne wali saheli ko tag karo!'
ideas.source: Trend: All the shaadis on the same few dates (patnapress.com) + Festival window shaadi dates 1-6 Dec (13-18 days, +2) + map-journey rotation (skip 34%)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Shruti reads the kitty group poll aloud: "December kitty ka theme? Red, sequin, winter white ya pajama?" chip 'POLL: 0-0-0-0'. Context: on every called number one lady campaigns for the theme that lets her reuse something (Ruhi: 'shaadi wali sequin saree ka second use!', Myra: 'white shawl toh hai hi', Shruti: 'red wali Karwa Chauth se rakhi hai'), and the chip ties 1-1-1-0. Ending: Tanya casts the last vote, "Pajama!", because she is the one with nothing to wear, and all three groan with their phones still showing their outfits.
ideas.format: Types-of with one stake chip (poll bars), 25-30 s, Housie table, max 3 per shot; caption 'Har kitty mein ek Tanya hoti hai jo theme apni almari dekh ke chunti hai. Tag her!'
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: December kitty theme planning + Types-of with one stake chip (skip 33.3%) + Nominate-your-friend call gets shares

ideas.idea: Santa pehchano: every lady brings one wrapped gift under Rs 200 with three clues about herself on the tag (favourite mithai, a saree colour she always wears, one habit) and no name; gifts are shuffled and handed out, and each lady reads her tag aloud and gets 3 guesses at her Secret Santa. Right guess, a point to her; three wrong, a point to the Santa. Crazy twist: when the host shouts "Ho ho ho!" everyone must pass her unopened gift two places to the right and guess for the new tag. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 to 20 minutes, gifts and tags only.
ideas.format: Kitty Game Ideas carousel: slide 1 'Christmas kitty game: apna Santa pehchano!' with a lady squinting at a gift tag, sample clues, how to play, the Ho ho ho twist, the winner; comment ask 'Aapki kitty mein sabse aasaan Santa kaun hai?'
ideas.source: Trend: Secret Santa with a twist (surfoffice.com, teambuilding.com) + Festival window: December kitty planning

ideas.idea: Teen shaadi, ek shaam: three chairs round the room are three shaadi halls, each with a task: hall 1, slip a toffee shagun into an envelope; hall 2, hold a selfie pose with the 'dulhan' (a cushion in a dupatta) for 3 seconds; hall 3, eat one piece of namkeen 'dinner'. Teams run it as a relay, each lady visits all three halls and tags the next. Crazy twist: when the host shouts "Baraat aa gayi!" the runner must stop and do 5 seconds of baraat dance on the spot before moving on. 8 to 20 ladies in 2 or 3 teams, 10 to 15 minutes, 3 chairs, envelopes, toffees, one cushion, namkeen.
ideas.format: Kitty Game Ideas carousel: slide 1 'Shaadi season kitty game: teen shaadi, ek shaam!' with a lady sprinting between chairs in a saree, setup of the 3 halls, relay rules, the Baraat twist, the winning team
ideas.source: Trend: All the shaadis on the same few dates (patnapress.com) + Festival window shaadi dates 1-6 Dec (+2)

ideas.idea: Christmas tree banao: teams of 4 or 5 pick one lady as the tree and get 2 minutes to dress her from a shared pile of household things (green dupattas, bangles as baubles, a steel plate star, ribbon from Diwali gift boxes, fairy lights if there are any). Crazy twist: the host then plays a song for 20 seconds and every tree must stand still while her team sings; anything that falls off counts zero, and the most decorated tree still standing wins. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes, only what is already in the house.
ideas.format: Kitty Game Ideas carousel: slide 1 'Christmas kitty game: saheli ko tree banao!' with a lady wrapped in green dupattas and bangles, what you need, rules, the freeze twist, the winning tree; comment ask 'Aapki kitty mein tree kaun banegi?'
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: December kitty planning (Christmas theme) + Household dexterity one-minute games

ideas.idea: Hook: doorbell, Tanya blocks her door in a silk saree holding the kitty pot: "December kitty, theme saree! Shawl utaaro, saree dikhao, phir entry!" chip 'SAREE DIKHI: 0/3'. Context: one guest per ring, each wrapped in a thick shawl; Ruhi opens hers on a nightsuit ('shaadi se late aayi!'), Myra on a sweater over her saree, Shruti on a thermal sleeve peeking out of her blouse, and the chip never moves. Ending: Tanya turns to let them in and her own pallu slips to show a full-sleeve thermal under her blouse; the three point together: "Entry nahi!"
ideas.format: Door-arrivals (25-28 s), dressed front door with a shoe rack and a shawl on the hook, max 3 per shot, a chip that stays stuck, host breaks her own rule; caption 'Har kitty mein ek Tanya hoti hai jo saree theme rakhti hai aur andar thermal pehenti hai. Tag her!'
ideas.source: Trend: Door-arrivals winner shape (LEARNINGS 2026-11-16, under 34% skip on 5 door reels) + first winter kitty in the Dec festival window (drikpanchang.com)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, the plates come round and Myra waves them off: "Main toh bas chai lungi." chip 'BAS CHAI · PLATE: 0'. Context: on every called number a new dish passes and Myra says the same line while taking one more (a samosa 'chai ke saath', a pakoda 'thanda ho jayega', gajar halwa 'Tanya ne banaya hai'), the chip climbs to 'PLATE: 6' and Ruhi and Shruti mouth the line with her. Ending: the host asks who wants chai and Myra's full plate is the only answer: "Chai? Nahi nahi, pet bhar gaya."
ideas.format: Meme-format with a climbing chip and one repeating catchphrase (25-28 s), Housie table in a dressed winter living room, max 3 per shot; caption 'Har kitty mein ek "main toh bas chai lungi" wali hoti hai. Tag her!'
ideas.source: Trend: Aunty one-liner as a catchphrase (theprint.in) + Chai and Parle-G Housie gets shares (our reels, 3 and 2 shares)

ideas.idea: Hook: last kitty of the year, Housie paused, Shruti opens the kitty diary like a phone screen: "Kitty 2026 Wrapped!" chip 'WRAPPED: 1/5'. Context: she reads one stat per beat to the face it belongs to: most late (Ruhi, 11 out of 12), most 'last Housie number' fights (Tanya), most gossip with 'kisi ko batana mat' (Ruhi again), most dishes ordered but called homemade (Myra), and each lady argues her number. Ending: the last stat is 'Total kitty pe kharcha: Rs 48,000' and all of them stare at Tanya, who has already started next year's diary.
ideas.format: Types-of recap with a progress chip (25-30 s), Shruti as hisaab-keeper, max 3 per shot, each stat a cut to one face; caption 'Aapki kitty ka 2026 Wrapped kya hoga? Tag your gang!'
ideas.source: Trend: Nominate-your-friend call gets shares (our reel, 8 shares) + Types-of with one stake chip (KG types-of 1674 views, skip 33.3%) + year-end recap season

ideas.idea: Parle-G dunk: every lady gets a cup of warm (not hot) chai and 5 Parle-G biscuits; on the host's call all dunk one biscuit and hold it in the chai while the host counts, and anyone whose biscuit breaks into the cup is out of that round; last biscuit standing wins, 5 rounds, longest dunker overall takes the prize. Crazy twist: when the host shouts "Saasu maa ka phone!" every lady must lift her cup to her ear like a phone with the biscuit still dunked and say "Haan mummy ji" before the count goes on.
ideas.format: Kitty Game Ideas carousel: slide 1 'Winter kitty game: Parle-G kitni der tikega?' with a lady staring at a drooping biscuit, what you need, how to play, the Saasu maa twist, the winner; comment ask 'Aapka biscuit kitne second tikta hai?'
ideas.source: Trend: Chai and Parle-G Housie gets shares (our reels, 3 and 2 shares)

ideas.idea: Katori minar: each lady gets 10 steel katoris, glasses and small dabbas and 1 minute to build the tallest tower using only one hand; if it falls she starts again from the bottom, and the tallest standing tower at the whistle wins (8 to 20 ladies in 2 or 3 rounds). Crazy twist: twice in the minute the host calls "Doorbell!" and every lady must run to touch the front door and come back before adding the next piece, while her neighbour may blow on her tower once.
ideas.format: Kitty Game Ideas carousel: slide 1 'Kitty party game: katori ka minar!' with a tall wobbling steel tower, what you need, rules, the Doorbell twist, the winning tower; comment ask 'Aapki kitty mein sabse steady haath kiska hai?'
ideas.source: Trend: One-minute stack, start again if it falls (venuelook.com)

ideas.idea: Aakhri muhurat Housie: a normal fast Housie round where the host also writes 5 'shaadi dates' (numbers 1 to 15) on a chit before starting; whenever a called number matches a shaadi date she shouts "Shaadi hai!" and every lady must pass her ticket to the left and keep playing on her neighbour's ticket with its cuts. Crazy twist: the last date on the chit is 'Kharmas' and when it comes up the game freezes for 10 seconds and the lady holding the most-cut ticket must do one baraat step before anyone can claim.
ideas.format: Kitty Game Ideas carousel: slide 1 'Shaadi season Housie: shaadi hai toh ticket badlo!' with ladies swapping tickets mid-round, setup, rules, the Kharmas twist, the winner; comment ask 'Aapko is December kitni shaadiyan attend karni hain?'
ideas.source: Trend: Housie variant carousel leads our games (KGI-026, 386 views, 2 shares, 5 saves) + Festival window: shaadi dates 1-6 Dec and Kharmas from 15-16 Dec (drikpanchang.com)

ideas.idea: Hook: doorbell, Tanya blocks her door holding her phone up with the kitty invite on it: "December kitty! Invite pe rules likhe the, padhe kisne?" chip 'RULES TODE: 0/4'. Context: one guest per ring breaks one rule from the card (Ruhi 40 minutes late, Myra brings last year's gift box, Shruti on a call with home) and the chip climbs as Tanya reads each rule aloud. Ending: the plates come round, Tanya bites a samosa and says "Thanda hai!", and the three guests read rule 4 back to her in one voice: "Khaane ki buraai mana hai!"
ideas.format: Kitty Gang door-arrivals reel, 25-30 s: front door set, the invite on a real phone screen, one guest per ring, rule chip climbing, host breaks her own rule; caption 'Tag your Tanya who writes the rules and breaks them first!'
ideas.source: Trend: Shaadi invite that lists rules for guests (shaadinews.com) + Door-arrivals is our winner, host breaks her own rule (skip 25-28%)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Ruhi in full shaadi make-up because she leaves for a reception after kitty, and her niece holds a phone on a ring light: "Mausi, ticket ek baar aur kaato, reel ke liye!" chip 'TAKE 1'. Context: on every number Ruhi cuts, the niece asks for a retake (pallu flip, slow-motion cut, a 'candid' laugh) while the gang waits with pens up and the chip climbs. Ending: on take 7 Shruti quietly says "Full House" on the same number, the niece swings the camera to her: "Yeh wala viral hoga," and Ruhi is left posing to nobody.
ideas.format: Kitty Gang sitcom reel, 25-30 s, opens on the game in progress; ring light and phone screen as props, take chip climbing, max 3 in a shot; caption 'Har kitty mein ek Ruhi hoti hai jo ticket bhi reel ke liye kaatti hai. Tag her!'
ideas.source: Trend: Click buddy: a guest brings her own reel crew (asianetnews.com) + Shaadi season kitty

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie paused, Tina walks in with a cake: "Is mahine ka kitty birthday: Myra!" chip 'JINGLE: 1/4'. Context: Tanya, Ruhi and Tina clap into a made-up jingle, "Aaj Myra ka birthday hai," and each line roasts a kitty habit of hers (always late, 'main toh bas chai lungi', the re-gifted dabba) while Myra keeps smiling for the photo. Ending: Myra blows the candle and declares "Birthday girl ka Full House pakka!", the next number is called, Ruhi shouts "Full House!", and the cake knife moves to Ruhi.
ideas.format: Kitty Gang sitcom reel, 25-30 s, birthday cake and candle on a dressed table, clap beat every 3 s as the repeating trigger, jingle chip; caption 'Aapki kitty ka birthday song kya hai? Comment karo!'
ideas.source: Trend: Homemade birthday jingle with claps (bolnews.com, 50,000+ reels) + Aunty one-liner as a catchphrase

ideas.idea: Click buddy: the room splits into pairs, one lady is the 'dulhan' and her partner the click buddy with her own phone; the host calls a shaadi pose (varmala with a dupatta, feeding a toffee as mithai, the slow dupatta walk, the jhumka check) and the buddy has 10 seconds to shoot it, then all phones go round and the room votes the best shot each round. Crazy twist: on "Reverse!" the dulhan shoots and the buddy poses, and any photo that is not vertical scores zero.
ideas.format: Kitty Game Ideas carousel: slide 1 'Shaadi season game: apni click buddy dhoondo!' with a lady posing and her partner filming, setup (8-20 ladies, pairs, own phones, 15 min), poses list, scoring, the Reverse twist; comment ask 'Aapki kitty mein sabse acchi photo kaun kheenchti hai? Tag her!'
ideas.source: Trend: Click buddy: a guest brings her own reel crew (asianetnews.com) + Shaadi dates 1-6 Dec

ideas.idea: Matar chhilo: every lady gets a heap of fresh pea pods (about 250 g) and an empty katori, and in 2 minutes shells as many as she can; the fullest katori, counted by the host's teaspoon, wins. Crazy twist: whenever the host shouts "Saas aayi!" everyone must stop, join hands and say "Namaste mummyji!", and anyone still shelling tips 5 dane into her neighbour's katori; at the end every lady's dane go into one pot for the host's matar paneer.
ideas.format: Kitty Game Ideas carousel: slide 1 'Winter kitty game: matar chhilo, saas aayi toh ruk jao!' with ladies racing over pea pods, setup (8-20 ladies, pea pods, katoris, 10-15 min), rules, the Saas aayi twist, the winner; comment ask 'Aapke ghar mein matar kaun chhilta hai?'
ideas.source: Trend: First winter spread: gajar halwa and sarson saag + Household dexterity one-minute games

ideas.idea: Birthday jingle: the host names a lady whose birthday is near and gives each team of 4 or 5 three words about her (her saree colour, her excuse for coming late, her favourite dish); in 2 minutes each team writes a 4-line birthday song using all three words and performs it with claps between lines, and the birthday lady picks the winner. Crazy twist: every team must sing to the tune the host picks from a chit (a bhajan, a baraat song, a lori or an ad jingle), and a team that claps out of beat starts the song again.
ideas.format: Kitty Game Ideas carousel: slide 1 'Kitty birthday game: 2 minute mein gaana banao!' with a team clapping round a cake, setup (8-20 ladies, teams, chits, 15 min), the three-word rule, the tune chit twist, the winner; comment ask 'Is mahine aapki kitty mein kiska birthday hai? Tag her!'
ideas.source: Trend: Homemade birthday jingle with claps (bolnews.com) + Nominate-your-friend call gets shares

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Shruti holds a steel ladle like a mic and looks into the lens: "Breaking news! Shaadi season kitty, aaj sab jaldi bhaagenge!" chip 'LIVE 1/3 · TICKET KATE: 0'. Context: she interviews one lady per beat while the numbers go on (Ruhi: 'aaj teen shaadi hain, sirf ek ghanta', Myra: 'shagun ka lifafa purse mein ready', Tanya the host: 'koi Full House se pehle nahi jaayega!') and the ticker climbs with each cut. Ending: Tanya's phone buzzes, "Reception 7 baje, abhi niklo!", she grabs her clutch mid-number and Shruti turns to camera: "Breaking: host khud bhaag gayi!"
ideas.format: News-bulletin gang reel (25-30 s), ladle mic and a LIVE ticker chip that moves every shot, Housie table in a dressed living room, max 3 per shot; caption 'Har shaadi season mein ek host hoti hai jo sabse pehle bhaagti hai. Tag her!'
ideas.source: Trend: News-bulletin format lifts a theme reel (TH-2026-11-20, skip 45.2%) + Festival window: shaadi dates 1-6 Dec (10-15 days, +2)

ideas.idea: Hook: 10 minutes before the kitty, Ruhi in a nightsuit at her mirror with a saree on the bed, chip 'GETTING READY: 10%'. Context: each cut is a call from home that stalls the bar (beta can't find his socks, the maid's 'kal nahi aaungi', saas asks for chai), she pins one pleat between each and the bar creeps 30, 60, 99. Ending: she rings the host's bell in full saree and jhumkas and the door opens on Tanya, Myra and Shruti in nightsuits and shawls: it was pajama kitty, the group message was unread, and the chip snaps back to 0%.
ideas.format: GRWM loading-bar sitcom (25-28 s), dressed bedroom mirror then the front door, one interruption per beat, a percent chip that climbs and resets, max 3 per shot; caption 'Tag the friend jo kitty ka message kabhi poora nahi padhti!'
ideas.source: Trend: GRWM with a loading bar (buffer.com, November 2026 sounds) + Progress chip that climbs and resets (our gossip reel, skip 35.6%)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie cage tumbling, Tanya calls out: "Aakhri 5 number, phir sab shaadi ke liye niklo!" chip 'NUMBER BAAKI: 5 · LADIES: 4'. Context: on each called number one lady's phone buzzes from downstairs (husband honking, the cab is here, 'baraat nikal gayi') and she leaves her ticket half cut on the sofa, so both numbers on the chip drop together. Ending: on the last number Tanya, alone in the room, picks up the abandoned tickets, finds Myra's is a Full House, and quietly puts the prize envelope in her own handbag: "Host ka Full House."
ideas.format: Countdown inside one story (25-28 s), Housie table in a dressed living room emptying shot by shot, a two-number chip that changes every shot, max 3 per shot; caption 'December ki kitty: number kam, ladies aur kam. Tag your gang!'
ideas.source: Trend: Countdown inside one story (KG-2026-11-12-b, skip 41.2%, watched 21%: so the stake changes every step and the end flips) + Festival window: shaadi dates 1-6 Dec (+2)

ideas.idea: Kitty samachar: each lady picks a chit with one kitty 'headline' ("Ruhi phir late", "Gajar halwa mein cheeni kam", "Host ne ticket mehenga kiya") and has 20 seconds to read it as a news anchor with a steel ladle as her mic, straight face, ending with "Dekhte rahiye Kitty Samachar!"; anyone who laughs is out and the room votes the best anchor. Crazy twist: whenever the host shouts "Ad break!" the anchor must instantly sell a random kitchen thing the host holds up (a belan, a lemon, a pressure cooker whistle) in a 5-second jingle before going back to the news. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes, chits, one ladle.
ideas.format: Kitty Game Ideas carousel: slide 1 'Kitty party game: ladle uthao, news padho!' with a lady holding a ladle mic and a straight face, sample headlines, rules, the Ad break twist, the winner; comment ask 'Aapki kitty ki sabse badi breaking news kya hai?'
ideas.source: Trend: News-bulletin format lifts a theme reel (TH-2026-11-20, skip 45.2%)

ideas.idea: 1 minute mein ready: pairs, one lady is the 'model' sitting on a chair and her partner gets 60 seconds to get her ready from a shared pile (a dupatta to drape, a bindi, 4 bangles, a clip-on earring, a shawl, sunglasses) while the host calls out the 'loading' at 25, 50 and 75 percent; the room votes the most kitty-ready look. Crazy twist: at 50 percent the host shouts "Network gaya!" and the dresser must freeze for 10 seconds while the model carries on alone with her eyes closed, and whatever ends up on her stays on for the photo.
ideas.format: Kitty Game Ideas carousel: slide 1 'Kitty party game: 1 minute mein ready ho jao!' with a lady half-draped and her partner racing, what you need, the loading calls, the Network gaya twist, the winning look; comment ask 'Aapko kitty ke liye ready hone mein kitna time lagta hai?'
ideas.source: Trend: GRWM with a loading bar (buffer.com, November 2026 sounds)

ideas.idea: Ulti ginti Housie: normal tickets, but the host announces that only 20 numbers will be called and counts down aloud with each one ("Bees baaki... unnees baaki..."); if nobody claims Full House by zero, the ticket with the most cuts wins, so everyone keeps counting her cuts out loud. Crazy twist: on every number ending in 0 the host shouts "Mehmaan aa gaye!" and every lady must hide her ticket under her dupatta and hold her pen like a serving spoon for 5 seconds, and anyone caught peeking loses one cut. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes, normal Housie tickets and pens.
ideas.format: Kitty Game Ideas carousel: slide 1 'Housie with a countdown: sirf 20 number!' with a lady counting cuts on her fingers, setup, the countdown rule, the Mehmaan twist, the winner; comment ask 'Aapki kitty mein Housie kitne number tak chalti hai?'
ideas.source: Trend: Countdown inside one story (KG-2026-11-12-b, 1894 views, skip 41.2%) + Housie variant carousel leads our games (KGI-026)

carousels.caption: Agli kitty mein yeh try karo. Haath nahi, sirf dhaage! Kaunsi team jeetegi?
Akhbaar chhota hota jaayega, masti badhti jaayegi! Agli kitty mein yeh khelo. Aapki jodi kitne round tiki?
Diwali kitty ke liye perfect! Munh mein chammach, chammach par diya, aur aakhri lady ko wish bhi bolni hai. Aapki team mein sabse pehle diya kaun giraayega?
Aankh band, munh meetha, aur galat jawab pe agli kitty ki mithai tumhari taraf se! Aap kitni mithai pehchaan logi?
Dice bolega kaunsi patti bharni hai, aur 1 aaya toh sheet hi badal jaayegi! Diwali kitty mein khelo. Aapki rangoli pehle poori hogi ya padosan ki?

carousels.tagline: Ek haath, do ladies, ek gift!
carousels.caption: Ek haath tumhara, ek partner ka, aur beech mein "Badlo!" Diwali kitty mein yeh gift packing race khelo. Aapki jodi ka dabba sundar banega ya ulta?
Pati poochte hain "Diwali pe kya chahiye?" aur hum kehte hain "kuch nahi". Is kitty mein A se Z sab likh do! Aapki X wali wish kya hogi?
Children's Day kitty ke liye! Kamar par pencil, saamne bottle, aur poora time Machli jal ki rani gaate raho. Aap kaunsi poem gaaoge?

carousels.tagline: Ek aankh, ek jhaadu, ek goal!
carousels.caption: Diwali safai ab game ban gayi! Ek aankh par dupatta, haath mein jhaadu, aur 30 second mein kachra goal ke paar. Aapki kitty ki Safai Queen kaun banegi?
Diwali taash party, par paise nahi! 5 patte ka ticket, host ki gaddi, aur Joker aate hi sab patte idhar udhar. Aapki kitty mein Taash Queen kaun banegi?
Diwali se pehle kitty mein yeh khelo! 1 minute, 5 diye, rui ki khadi batti, aur beech beech mein Lakshmi ji aa jaati hain. Aap 1 minute mein kitni battiyan bana logi?
Chhath aur Dev Diwali se pehle kitty mein yeh khelo! Parat ka ghat, kaagaz ki naav, LED diya aur sirf ek straw. Aapki naav paar hogi ya diya doobega?
Shaadi season aa gaya, packing ka race bhi! 60 second, 12 cheezein aur beech mein pati ka kurta. Aapki jodi kitni cheezein ghusa paayegi?
Shaadi season aa gaya! Host rishta bolegi, aapko jhat se sahi shagun lifafe mein daalna hai, aur 1 ka sikka bhoole toh kanjoos. Aapke group mein sabse kanjoos kaun nikalegi?
Tulsi Vivah aa raha hai, mandap aap banao! 3 minute, 4 belan aur beech mein baraat late. Aapki team ka mandap khada rahega?
Choti si chotiyon wali bachchi aaj kitty ki queen hai! Children's Day pe yeh khelo. Aapki bachpan photo kaun pehchaanega?
Parcel khula aur moza nikla? Ab haath mein pehno! Sardi ki pehli kitty mein yeh khelo. Aapke parcel mein kya daaloge?
Chudi phenko, bottle pakdo, aur mehendi call pe sirf ungliyon se! Shaadi season ki kitty mein yeh khelo. Aapka score kitna aayega?
Chudi giri M pe! Ab 60 second mein M se ek rasam, gaana, khaana, gehna aur rishtedaar likho. Comment mein aapke paanch jawab?
Saaliyan chappal chupayengi, gaana clue dega, aur milne ke baad neg ka mol-bhav! Shaadi season ki kitty ke liye perfect. Aap kitna neg maangti?
Baraat ka gaana bajega, phir host bolegi "Phere chaar!" aur 5 second mein group banana hai. Mascot pe hansi toh out! Aapki kitty mein sabse pehle kaun out hoga?
Mehendi geeli hai, haathon pe moze hain, aur 1 minute mein toffee, clip aur Housie, teeno karne hain! Aapki kitty mein sabse fast dulhan kaun?
Aankh pe patti, tray mein amla bhi aur nimbu bhi, aur team sirf left right bol sakti hai! Aapki kitty mein aloo ko shakarkandi kaun samjhegi?
Host ek baar dance dikhayegi, phir team ko sync mein yaad se karna hai. "Mamaji aa gaye!" pe naya step judega! Aapki kitty mein sabse achha thumka kiska hai?
Dice pe chhakka aaya toh phera, ek aaya toh bidaai ka rona! Shaadi season ki kitty mein yeh zaroor khelo. Aapki kitty mein sabse filmy bidaai kaun karegi?
Housie wahi, bas sir pe katori! Giri toh ticket padosan ki. Aapki kitty mein sabse pehle kiski katori giregi?

carousels.tagline: Ek haath, ek channi, hasi mana!
carousels.caption: Ek haath se sehra banao, aur dulha hasi toh 15 second ruko! Shaadi season ki kitty ke liye perfect. Aapki gang mein sabse pehle kaun hasegi?
8 award, ek dupatta sash aur 10 second ki filmy speech. Hasi aayi toh award gaya! Aapki kitty mein sabse late kaun aata hai? Tag karo!
Housie wahi, bas host bolegi nahi, sirf acting! Aur "Fufaji naraz!" pe sheet padosan ki. Aapki kitty mein sabse funny acting kaun karega?
Shaadi season mein yeh kitty game zaroor khelo! Dulha akdegi, dost toffee pe bik jaayegi. Aapki kitty mein sabse jaldi kaun bikegi?
Shaadi season mein ek shaam, teen shaadi! Shagun do, dulhan ke saath selfie lo, dinner karo aur agli ko tag karo. Is December aapko kitni shaadiyan attend karni hain?

research.pattern: Festival window: shaadi dates 1-6 Dec + Vivah Panchami 14 Dec + Champa Shashti 15 Dec + Dhanu Sankranti and Kharmas 16 Dec + Gita Jayanti and Vaikuntha Ekadashi 20 Dec + Datta Jayanti 23 Dec + Christmas 25 Dec
research.source: December festivals 2026 (drikpanchang.com) + December 2026 Festivals State-Wise in India (hindutone.com)
research.learn: Drafts from today post about 1 Dec, so the 1-6 Dec shaadi rush (10-15 days, +2) and 'last kitty before Kharmas' are the live hooks; Vivah Panchami is 23 days out (no +2 yet) and Gita Jayanti is 19 or 20 Dec depending on the calendar, so never print that date on screen.

research.pattern: News-bulletin format lifts a theme reel
research.source: Our theme reel 'Breaking: Aangan mein shaadi!' (TH-2026-11-20, variant news-bulletin)
research.learn: Skip 45.2% against 60-75% for every other theme reel that week (442 views, watched 16%): a reporter with a 'LIVE 1/4' ticker interviewing one lady per beat gives a clear hook and a counter; reuse the bulletin shape in a gang reel, but the middle still needs a stake to move.

research.pattern: Countdown inside one story: strong hook, weak middle
research.source: Our reel 'Phone band karne wali ka hi phone pehle bajta hai' (KG-2026-11-12-b, countdown)
research.learn: 1894 views and skip 41.2% (vs 49 reach for the first countdown) but watched only 21% and 0 shares: a countdown chip with one want hooks well, yet viewers leave once they can guess the end, so every step must change the stake and the last number must flip the story.

research.source: 13 Trending Sounds on Instagram in November 2026 (buffer.com): getting-ready 'loading screen' format
research.learn: Getting ready shown as a loading bar that creeps up between interruptions is a trending shape; every kitty lady's last 10 minutes before leaving home (calls, kids, saas, the pallu pin) fits it, with the bar as the moving chip and a reset as the ending.

research.pattern: Festival window: shaadi dates 1-6 Dec + Margashirsha Amavasya 8 Dec + Vivah Panchami 13-14 Dec + Dhanu Sankranti and Kharmas 16 Dec + Christmas 25 Dec
research.source: December festivals 2026 (drikpanchang.com) + December 2026 Hindu Festivals (hindutone.com)
research.learn: Drafts from today post about 30 Nov onward, so the early December shaadi dates (11-16 days out, +2) and the last shaadi before Kharmas are the live hooks; Vivah Panchami and Christmas are planning hooks only, and calendars disagree on Vivah Panchami (13 or 14 Dec), so never print that date on screen.

research.pattern: Shaadi invite that lists rules for guests
research.source: Indian wedding guests get a hilarious roast in viral invite: 'Khaane ki buraai...' (shaadinews.com)
research.learn: A card or message that spells out the rules every guest secretly breaks (no food complaints, no late arrival, no gift repeats) is instantly relatable; our kitty invite in the group can carry the rules, and the host breaking one of her own rules is the payoff.

research.pattern: Click buddy: a guest brings her own reel crew
research.source: From Shaadi to Social Media: 'Click Buddy' at Indian weddings turn guests into Instagram stars (newsable.asianetnews.com)
research.learn: Guests now get a personal phone-and-ring-light shooter at shaadis; in a kitty the same idea is a niece or nephew filming one lady for a reel, so retakes stall the room, and the candid moment the shooter misses is the joke.

research.source: Instagram's new trend 'Aaj Meri Behen Ka Birthday Hai' (bolnews.com)
research.learn: An off-key made-up birthday song with claps between lines was reused in 50,000+ reels; every kitty cuts a cake for the month's birthday lady, so a gang jingle where each line roasts her kitty habit is a real scene with a built-in repeating beat (evergreen pattern, the audio itself is old).

research.pattern: Festival window: shaadi dates 1-6 Dec + Utpanna Ekadashi 4 Dec + Vivah Panchami 14 Dec + Kharmas from Dhanu Sankranti 15-16 Dec
research.source: December festivals 2026 (drikpanchang.com) + December 2026 Hindu Festivals (hindupad.com)
research.learn: Drafts from today post about 29 Nov onward, so the early December shaadi dates are 12-17 days out (+2); Dhanu Sankranti starts Kharmas and stops weddings till mid-January, so 'last shaadi before the break' and the first proper winter kitty are the hooks; Vivah Panchami and Christmas are still planning hooks only.

research.pattern: Chai and Parle-G Housie gets shares
research.source: Our reels 'Let's do Chai pe Charcha & Play Housie' and 'Chai, Parle G and Housie'
research.learn: 461 views with 3 shares and 2 saves, and 180 views with 2 shares, against 0 shares on most posts this week: winter chai plus a nostalgic biscuit is a share-friendly cue, so put a real chai-and-biscuit moment (dunking, the last biscuit, the second cup) into winter reels and games.

research.source: Indian aunties finally have their time in the laddoo peela sun (theprint.in)
research.learn: Aunty quips go viral as repeatable one-liners that people lip-sync and quote; give one gang lady a signature line that comes back on every beat and contradicts what we see, so the viewer tags the friend who says it.

research.pattern: One-minute stack, start again if it falls
research.source: Hilarious One-Minute Games for Your Next Kitty Party: Stack It Up (venuelook.com)
research.learn: The evergreen 1-minute game shape is a tower of small household things that resets when it topples; use our own kitchen props and add a host call that forces a move mid-stack.

research.pattern: Festival window: shaadi dates 1-6 Dec and 11-13 Dec + Vivah Panchami 14 Dec + December kitty theme planning + Christmas 25 Dec
research.source: Shubh vivah muhurat December 2026 (vedicfeed.com) + December 2026 Hindu Festivals (hindutone.com)
research.learn: New drafts post about 28 Nov onward, so the timely hooks are the early December shaadi dates (13-18 days out, +2) and the end-of-November kitty where the December theme and Secret Santa chits get decided; Christmas itself (37 days) is only a planning hook for now.

research.pattern: All the shaadis on the same few dates
research.source: Only 13 auspicious wedding dates in November and December this year (patnapress.com)
research.learn: With so few muhurats every family has two or three shaadis on one evening; the hall-hopping evening (photo with the dulhan, lifafa, run) is a one-glance real scene for a map-journey reel or a relay game.

research.source: Secret Santa games: dice exchange, guess your Santa from clues (surfoffice.com, teambuilding.com)
research.learn: December kitties run a gift exchange and draw the chits a month ahead; copy the twist shapes (dice swaps, guess the giver from clues) onto a kitty gift exchange and onto the chit draw at the door.

research.pattern: Housie variant carousel leads our games
research.source: Our carousel 'Housie wahi, bas sir pe katori! Giri toh ticket padosan ki.' (KGI-026)
research.learn: 334 views, 2 shares, 2 saves in two days, about twice the Sehra Bandhi carousel (176 views, 1 share); a known game (Housie) with one physical twist is easier to save than a brand-new game, so keep one Housie variant in every few game ideas.

research.pattern: Festival window: shaadi dates 21-26 Nov + Kalbhairav Jayanti 1 Dec + Vivah Panchami 14 Dec + Gita Jayanti 19-20 Dec + Dattatreya Jayanti 23 Dec
research.source: Vivah Panchami 2026: Date (14 December), Ram Sita Vivah Story, Janakpur and Puja at Home (hindutone.com) + Hindu Festivals 2026 list (hindu-blog.com)
research.learn: Gurpurab and Dev Deepawali (24 Nov) are 7 days out but new drafts post about 10 days later, so they are already stale for us; the next festival hook is Vivah Panchami (14 Dec, +2 from 23 Nov) as the shaadi-season peak, with first winter and December pre-boards carrying the gap.

research.source: Our reel 'Follow @kittyparty.app and Comment Kitty. Let's find out our Top 100 Kitty Party Content Creator'
research.learn: 1763 views, 9 saves, 8 shares: the most shares any post got this week, from a simple ask to name a kitty lady; end reels and carousels on 'who in your kitty is the ___?' so the viewer sends it to one real friend.

research.pattern: Festival reel posted after the day sinks
research.source: Our reel 'Fancy dress school ka, costume host ke ghar ka. Tag the friend jiske ghar se costume banta hai!' (Children's Day, posted 16 Nov)
research.learn: 270 views, skip 45.7%, 0 shares when it posted two days after Children's Day, while the same week's non-festival gang reels did 1300-2300; with a 10-day queue, pick festival ideas only 12+ days out or keep the joke evergreen.

research.pattern: Pehle chup, ab jawab: answer-back voiceover
research.source: New Instagram trend 'Pehle mein ek kaan se sunkar dusre se nikaal thi' inspires reels (freepressjournal.in, about 45.6K reels on the audio)
research.learn: A 'used to ignore it, now I answer back' line to camera is being copied widely; our version is the quiet kitty lady who finally answers the host's rules with the hisaab, never their audio or words.

research.pattern: Yellow is the shaadi colour of 2026
